```
//
// Emits the semantic design tokens from docs/design-system/03-design-tokens.md as
// CSS custom properties on :root. Imported once by style.scss, after the theme
// `vars` file has defined `$is_light_theme` and `$is_summer`, so each of the four
// compiled builds (warm light/dark, summer light/dark) emits its own values.
//
// Values are branched on palette + mode and mirror the documented token tables:
//   - Warm Harvest (default): 03-design-tokens.md §2.2 (as remapped by 08 §3)
//   - Summer (classic): the original green/blue palette
// Components consume var(--...) from Phase 2 onward.

@import "vars";

$is_summer: false !default;

:root {
    // --- Color: surfaces & text ---
    @if $is_summer {
        @if $is_light_theme {
            // Summer = the classic palette; tokens mirror the legacy $color_* values
            // exactly so migrated components render identically to the original look.
            --color-canvas: #f8f8f8;
            --color-surface: #ffffff;
            --color-surface-raised: #ffffff;
            --color-surface-alt: #eeeeee;
            --color-border: #cccccc;
            --color-border-strong: #808080;
            --color-text: #111111;
            --color-text-secondary: #555555;
            --color-text-muted: #808080;
            --color-text-inverse: #ffffff;

            --color-accent: #1ba94c;
            --color-accent-hover: #158a3e;
            --color-accent-contrast: #ffffff;
            --color-accent-2: #5fc27e;
            --color-navbar: #045c20;

            --color-link: #1958c1;
            --color-link-hover: #0645ad;
            --color-focus-ring: #1958c1;
            --color-focus-ring-soft: rgba(25, 88, 193, 0.25);

            --color-info-bg: #ddeeff;
            --color-info-fg: #26536b;
            --color-success-bg: #ddf3e4;
            --color-success-fg: #177a3a;
            --color-warning-bg: #fff3cd;
            --color-warning-fg: #8a6100;
            --color-danger-bg: #f8dcdc;
            --color-danger-fg: #a52222;
        } @else {
            // Summer dark = classic dark palette; tokens mirror the legacy values.
            --color-canvas: #222222;
            --color-surface: #111111;
            --color-surface-raised: #181818;
            --color-surface-alt: #181818;
            --color-border: #3b3b3b;
            --color-border-strong: #808080;
            --color-text: #f8f8f8;
            --color-text-secondary: #aaaaaa;
            --color-text-muted: #808080;
            --color-text-inverse: #ffffff;

            --color-accent: #1ba94c;
            --color-accent-hover: #5fc27e;
            --color-accent-contrast: #ffffff;
            --color-accent-2: #5fc27e;
            --color-navbar: #0f1214;

            --color-link: #6bb0f5;
            --color-link-hover: #8fc4ff;
            --color-focus-ring: #6bb0f5;
            --color-focus-ring-soft: rgba(107, 176, 245, 0.25);

            --color-info-bg: #002233;
            --color-info-fg: #77ddff;
            --color-success-bg: #0e3a22;
            --color-success-fg: #66ff88;
            --color-warning-bg: #3a2e05;
            --color-warning-fg: #ffdd66;
            --color-danger-bg: #3a1414;
            --color-danger-fg: #ff9999;
        }
    } @else {
        // Warm Harvest (default palette)
        @if $is_light_theme {
            --color-canvas: #fbf6ef;
            --color-surface: #ffffff;
            --color-surface-raised: #ffffff;
            --color-surface-alt: #f4ebdd;
            --color-border: #e4d5c1;
            --color-border-strong: #d3bfa4;
            --color-text: #2e241c;
            --color-text-secondary: #6e5d4e;
            --color-text-muted: #8a7360;
            --color-text-inverse: #ffffff;

            --color-accent: #c1440e;
            --color-accent-hover: #9e3609;
            --color-accent-contrast: #ffffff;
            --color-accent-2: #e0a82e;
            --color-navbar: #7a2906;

            // Links use the warm sienna family (not teal) to match the autumn
            // brand. #c1440e clears AA on white (5.12:1) and paper (~4.8:1).
            --color-link: #c1440e;
            --color-link-hover: #7a2906;
            --color-focus-ring: #c1440e;
            --color-focus-ring-soft: rgba(193, 68, 14, 0.25);

            --color-info-bg: #d9eef2;
            --color-info-fg: #1f5c6b;
            --color-success-bg: #ddf3e4;
            --color-success-fg: #177a3a;
            --color-warning-bg: #fff3cd;
            --color-warning-fg: #8a6100;
            --color-danger-bg: #f8dcdc;
            --color-danger-fg: #a52222;
        } @else {
            --color-canvas: #1a1512;
            --color-surface: #2e241c;
            --color-surface-raised: #4a3b2f;
            --color-surface-alt: #4a3b2f;
            --color-border: #4a3b2f;
            --color-border-strong: #6e5d4e;
            --color-text: #f4ebdd;
            --color-text-secondary: #a8907a;
            --color-text-muted: #a8907a;
            --color-text-inverse: #ffffff;

            --color-accent: #e07b39;
            --color-accent-hover: #f6cdb6;
            --color-accent-contrast: #120e0b;
            --color-accent-2: #e9c46a;
            --color-navbar: #120e0b;

            // Links use the warm pumpkin/gold family (not teal) to match autumn.
            --color-link: #e07b39;
            --color-link-hover: #e9c46a;
            --color-focus-ring: #e07b39;
            --color-focus-ring-soft: rgba(224, 123, 57, 0.25);

            --color-info-bg: #0d2b33;
            --color-info-fg: #5fb3c4;
            --color-success-bg: #0e3a22;
            --color-success-fg: #66ff88;
            --color-warning-bg: #3a2e05;
            --color-warning-fg: #ffdd66;
            --color-danger-bg: #3a1414;
            --color-danger-fg: #ff9999;
        }
    }

    // --- Color: rating tiers (protected layer, identical across palettes) ---
    @if $is_light_theme {
        --rating-none: #999999;
        --rating-newbie: #808080;
        --rating-pupil: #008000;
        --rating-specialist: #03a89e;
        --rating-expert: #0000ff;
        --rating-candidate-master: #aa00aa;
        --rating-master: #ff8c00;
        --rating-grandmaster: #ff0000;
    } @else {
        --rating-none: #aaaaaa;
        --rating-newbie: #988f81;
        --rating-pupil: #72ff72;
        --rating-specialist: #57fcf2;
        --rating-expert: #337dff;
        --rating-candidate-master: #ff55ff;
        --rating-master: #ff981a;
        --rating-grandmaster: #ff1a1a;
    }

    // --- Color: verdict badges (protected layer; theme-dependent, palette-
    // independent). Solid-fill bg + fg, AA-verified per 03-design-tokens.md §2.3. ---
    @if $is_light_theme {
        --verdict-ac-bg: #1a7f37;   --verdict-ac-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-partial-bg: #8a6d00;  --verdict-partial-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-wa-bg: #c1121f;   --verdict-wa-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-tle-bg: #1f6feb;  --verdict-tle-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-mle-bg: #0b5fa4;  --verdict-mle-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-ole-bg: #8a4b00;  --verdict-ole-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-rte-bg: #9a3412;  --verdict-rte-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-ir-bg: #7a2e0e;   --verdict-ir-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-ce-bg: #5a4a2a;   --verdict-ce-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-ie-bg: #a11043;   --verdict-ie-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-ab-bg: #5b5b5b;   --verdict-ab-fg: #ffffff;
        --verdict-queued-bg: #e4d5c1;   --verdict-queued-fg: #2e241c;
    } @else {
        --verdict-ac-bg: #2ea043;   --verdict-ac-fg: #0a0a0a;
        --verdict-partial-bg: #d9b310;  --verdict-partial-fg: #0a0a0a;
        --verdict-wa-bg: #f28b96;   --verdict-wa-fg: #2a0608;
        --verdict-tle-bg: #6cb0f5;  --verdict-tle-fg: #08132b;
        --verdict-mle-bg: #4aa3df;  --verdict-mle-fg: #06121f;
        --verdict-ole-bg: #e0913b;  --verdict-ole-fg: #241202;
        --verdict-rte-bg: #f08a4b;  --verdict-rte-fg: #2a1102;
        --verdict-ir-bg: #e08a5b;   --verdict-ir-fg: #25100a;
        --verdict-ce-bg: #c9b184;   --verdict-ce-fg: #1c150a;
        --verdict-ie-bg: #f2789f;   --verdict-ie-fg: #2a0512;
        --verdict-ab-bg: #b8b8b8;   --verdict-ab-fg: #141414;
        --verdict-queued-bg: #4a3b2f;   --verdict-queued-fg: #f4ebdd;
    }

    // --- Navbar impersonation state (palette-independent) ---
    --color-navbar-impersonate: #893e89;

    // --- Spacing (4px base) ---
    --space-0: 0;
    --space-1: 4px;
    --space-2: 8px;
    --space-3: 12px;
    --space-4: 16px;
    --space-5: 24px;
    --space-6: 32px;
    --space-7: 48px;
    --space-8: 64px;

    // --- Radius ---
    --radius-sm: 4px;
    --radius-md: 8px;
    --radius-lg: 12px;
    --radius-pill: 999px;

    // --- Layout (Phase 6) ---
    --container-max: 1120px;
    --container-wide: 1320px;
    --section-gap: 48px;
    --card-pad: 24px;

    // --- Elevation ---
    @if $is_light_theme {
        --shadow-0: none;
        --shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.08);
        --shadow-2: 0 2px 8px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.1);
        --shadow-3: 0 8px 24px rgba(16, 24, 32, 0.14);
    } @else {
        --shadow-0: none;
        --shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        --shadow-2: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
        --shadow-3: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }

    // --- Typography ---
    --font-ui: "Inter", "Segoe UI", "Lucida Grande", Arial, sans-serif;
    --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Fira Code", Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace;

    --text-xs: 12px;
    --text-sm: 13px;
    --text-base: 15px;
    --text-md: 17px;
    --text-lg: 20px;
    --text-xl: 24px;
    --text-2xl: 30px;

    --leading-xs: 1.4;
    --leading-sm: 1.45;
    --leading-base: 1.55;
    --leading-md: 1.5;
    --leading-lg: 1.4;
    --leading-xl: 1.3;
    --leading-2xl: 1.25;

    --weight-regular: 400;
    --weight-medium: 500;
    --weight-semibold: 600;
    --weight-bold: 700;

    // --- Motion ---
    --motion-fast: 120ms;
    --motion-base: 200ms;
    --motion-slow: 320ms;
    --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);

    // --- Z-index ---
    --z-base: 0;
    --z-dropdown: 1000;
    --z-navbar: 1000;
    --z-overlay: 1100;
    --z-modal: 1110;
    --z-toast: 1200;
}
```

```
// Reusable layout utilities (Phase 6, docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md).
// Token-driven, palette/theme-agnostic. No colors here beyond token references.

@import "vars";

// Centered, max-width content wrapper with responsive side padding.
.u-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: var(--container-max);
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    padding-left: var(--space-4);
    padding-right: var(--space-4);
    box-sizing: border-box;

    &.u-container-wide {
        max-width: var(--container-wide);
    }
}

// Responsive auto-fill card grid. Set --u-grid-min per usage to tune column width.
.u-grid-auto {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--u-grid-min, 260px), 1fr));
    gap: var(--space-4);
}

// Vertical spacing stack.
.u-stack {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--u-stack-gap, var(--space-4));
}

// Horizontal cluster with wrapping.
.u-cluster {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--u-cluster-gap, var(--space-2));
}

// Standardized section header: title on the left, optional action on the right.
.section-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: 0 0 var(--space-4);

    .section-head-title {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--text-lg);
        font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
        color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .section-head-action {
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        white-space: nowrap;
    }
}

// Consistent centered empty state (lists with no results).
.empty-state {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-4);
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);

    .empty-state-icon {
        font-size: 2.5em;
        color: var(--color-text-muted);
        line-height: 1;
    }

    .empty-state-message {
        font-size: var(--text-md);
    }
}
```

```
@import "vars";

$is_light_theme: true;

.social i {
    display: inline;
    font-size: 1.9em;
}

.facebook-this, .tweet-this {
    display: inline;
}

.tweet-this i {
    color: #55ACEE;
}

.facebook-this i {
    color: #133783;
}

.social {
    font-size: 1.3em;
    float: right;
}

// Buttons (design-system primitive). Default variant is the brand accent; see
// docs/design-system/05-component-specs.md §5.2. Colors come from tokens so both
// palettes (Warm Harvest / Summer) and both themes stay in sync.
.button, button, input[type=submit] {
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    cursor: pointer;
    vertical-align: middle;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
    line-height: 1.4;
    background: var(--color-accent);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    display: block;
    border: 0;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
    transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        box-shadow var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

    // 4k hack
    font-size: $base_font_size;

    &:hover {
        background: var(--color-accent-hover);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    &:active {
        background: var(--color-accent-hover);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
        transform: translateY(0);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    &.full {
        padding: var(--space-2) 0;
    }

    // Secondary / neutral button variant.
    &.btn-secondary, &.btn-gray {
        background: var(--color-surface-raised);
        color: var(--color-text) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);

        &:hover, &:active {
            background: var(--color-surface-alt);
        }
    }

    // Danger variant.
    &.btn-danger, &.delete {
        background: var(--color-danger-fg);
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast) !important;

        &:hover, &:active {
            filter: brightness(0.92);
        }
    }

    &.disabled, &:disabled {
        opacity: 0.55;
        cursor: not-allowed;
    }
}

.inline-button {
    display: inline;
    vertical-align: top;
    padding: 3px 6px;
}

// Reusable card/surface family (design-system spec 5.5, extended in phase 6a).
// Generalizes the blog's card treatment so every feature shares one surface style.
.card {
    background: var(--color-surface-raised);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    padding: var(--card-pad);

    &.card-flat {
        box-shadow: none;
    }

    &.card-raised {
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
    }

    // Interactive card: lifts on hover/focus-within. Motion is disabled globally
    // under prefers-reduced-motion (base.scss).
    &.card--interactive {
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
        transition: transform var(--motion-base) var(--ease-standard),
            box-shadow var(--motion-base) var(--ease-standard);

        &:hover, &:focus-within {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        }
    }

    // Card with a media/image header that bleeds to the card edges.
    &.card--media {
        padding: 0;
        overflow: hidden;

        > .card__body, > .card__footer, > .card__title, > .card__meta {
            padding-left: var(--card-pad);
            padding-right: var(--card-pad);
        }
    }
}

.card__title {
    margin: 0 0 var(--space-2);
    font-size: var(--text-lg);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    color: var(--color-text);
}

.card__meta {
    color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
}

.card__body {
    color: var(--color-text);
}

.card__footer {
    margin-top: var(--space-3);
    padding-top: var(--space-3);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

input {
    &[type=text], &[type=password], &[type=email], &[type=number], &[type=url] {
        padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
        color: var(--color-text);
        background: var(--color-surface) none;
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
            box-shadow var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
        box-sizing: border-box;

        // Need this explicitly because UA stylesheet for Chrome on 4k makes
        // everything look bad otherwise (forces it to 9.3px)
        font-size: $base_font_size;

        &:hover {
            border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        }

        &:focus {
            border-color: var(--color-accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus-ring-soft);
            outline: 0;
        }
    }

    &[type=number] {
        padding: 2px 0 2px 5px;
    }

    &[type=checkbox] {
        appearance: none;
        vertical-align: middle;
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong);
        background: var(--color-surface);
        border-radius: 2px;
        width: 0.95em;
        height: 0.95em;
        cursor: pointer;

        &:checked {
            appearance: auto;
            accent-color: $highlight_blue;
        }
    }
}

textarea {
    padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
    color: $color_primary75;
    background: var(--color-surface) none;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    transition: border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        box-shadow var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

textarea:hover {
    border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
}

textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--color-accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus-ring-soft);
    outline: 0;
}

// Bootstrap-y copy button
.btn-clipboard {
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    display: block;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    background-color: $color_pageBg;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 0 $widget_border_radius;
    position: absolute;
    padding: 5px 8px;
}

.copy-clipboard {
    position: relative;
    margin-top: 1.5em;
}

// Bootstrap-y tabs
.ul_tab_a_active {
    color: var(--color-text);
    // Cover up the bottom border of active tabs with this color
    background: $color_pageBg;
    cursor: default;
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-bottom-color: $color_pageBg;
    border-image: none;
}

.tabs {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

    .tab {
        .tab-icon {
            padding-right: 0.3em;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);

            &.fa-plus {
                color: var(--color-success-fg) !important;
            }
        }

        a, span {
            border-top-width: 3px !important;
        }

        &.active {
            a, span {
                border-top-color: var(--color-accent) !important;
            }

            .tab-icon {
                color: var(--color-text);
            }
        }
    }

    h2 {
        color: var(--color-text);
    }

    > ul {
        margin: 0;
        margin-bottom: -1px;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: outside none none;
        display: flex;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;

        > li {
            position: relative;
            display: block;

            &.active > a, &.active > span {
                @extend .ul_tab_a_active;

                &:hover {
                    @extend .ul_tab_a_active;
                }

                &:focus {
                    @extend .ul_tab_a_active;
                }
            }

            > a, > span {
                margin-right: 2px;
                line-height: 1.42857;
                border: 1px solid transparent;
                border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0;
                position: relative;
                display: block;
                padding: 10px 15px;
                color: var(--color-text-muted);
                text-decoration: none;
                white-space: nowrap;
                transition: color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
                    background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
            }

            > a:hover {
                color: var(--color-text);
                background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Bootstrap-y pagination
ul.pagination a:hover {
    background: var(--color-surface-alt);
}

ul.pagination {
    display: inline-block;
    padding-left: 0;
    margin: 0;

    > {
        li {
            display: inline;

            &:first-child > {
                a, span {
                    margin-left: 0;
                    border-top-left-radius: $widget_border_radius;
                    border-bottom-left-radius: $widget_border_radius;
                }
            }

            &:last-child > {
                a, span {
                    border-top-right-radius: $widget_border_radius;
                    border-bottom-right-radius: $widget_border_radius;
                }
            }

            > {
                a, span {
                    position: relative;
                    float: left;
                    padding: 6px 13px;
                    line-height: 1.42857;
                    text-decoration: none;
                    color: var(--color-link);
                    background-color: var(--color-surface);
                    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
                    margin-left: -1px;
                    transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
                        color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
                }
            }
        }

        .disabled-page > {
            a, span {
                color: var(--color-text-muted);
            }
        }

        .active-page > {
            a, span {
                z-index: 2;
                color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
                background-color: var(--color-accent);
                border-color: transparent;
                cursor: default;
            }
        }
    }
}

.top-pagination-bar {
    margin: 11px 0 7px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.bottom-pagination-bar {
    margin-top: 10px;
}

// Alerts / messages (spec 5.10): semantic token backgrounds + a left accent bar
// in the level color. Icon/text pairing (never color-only) is provided by markup.
.alert {
    padding: var(--space-4);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-left-width: 4px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

.alert-info {
    color: var(--color-info-fg);
    background-color: var(--color-info-bg);
    border-color: var(--color-info-fg);
}

.alert-warning {
    color: var(--color-warning-fg);
    background-color: var(--color-warning-bg);
    border-color: var(--color-warning-fg);
}

.alert-danger {
    color: var(--color-danger-fg);
    background-color: var(--color-danger-bg);
    border-color: var(--color-danger-fg);
}

.alert-success {
    color: var(--color-success-fg);
    background-color: var(--color-success-bg);
    border-color: var(--color-success-fg);
}

.alert-dismissable, .alert-dismissible {
    padding-right: 35px;
}

.alert-dismissable .close, .alert-dismissible .close {
    position: relative;
    top: -2px;
    right: -21px;
    color: inherit;
}

.close {
    float: right;
    font-size: 21px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--color-text);
    filter: alpha(opacity=20);
    opacity: 0.2;
}

a.close {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    font-size: 18px !important;
    line-height: 1;

    &:hover {
        color: var(--color-text);
    }
}

.close {
    &:focus, &:hover {
        color: #000;
        text-decoration: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        filter: alpha(opacity=50);
        opacity: 0.5;
    }
}

.badge {
    min-width: 10px;
    padding: 0 7px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    vertical-align: middle;
    background-color: #e84848;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.form-submit-group {
    border-top: 1px solid rgba($color_primary100, 0.1);
    margin-top: 0.8em;
    padding-top: 0.5em;
    text-align: right;
}

.sidebox h3 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    margin: 0;
    background: $color_navbar_bg;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg) 0 0;
    @if $is_light_theme {
        color: #fff;
    } 
    @else {
        color: #ccc;
    }
    padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1.25;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: 1.3em;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.sidebox h3 .fa {
    color: #ccc;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    float: none;
    margin: 0;
    width: 1.1em;
    height: 1.1em;
    line-height: 1;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    overflow: visible;
}

.sidebox h3 .sidebox-count {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 1.8em;
    height: 1.5em;
    padding: 0 0.4em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    font-size: 0.58em;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 700;
    background: rgba($color_primary0, 0.18);
    color: $color_primary0;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.sidebox-content {
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-top: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem 0.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;

    &.sidebox-table {
        border: none;
        padding: 0;

        .table {
            margin: 0 !important;
        }
    }
}

// Sidebox cards (home page + others). Card surface + subtle elevation from the
// token layer for a cohesive, modern look across palettes/themes.
.sidebox {
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
    padding: 0 !important;
    padding-bottom: 1rem !important;
    overflow: hidden;
}

}

.messages {

        &.success {

        }

        &.warning {
            color: #856404;

        }

        &.error {
            color: #721c24;
            background-color: #f8d7da;
            border-color: #f5c6cb;
        }
    }
}

details {

}
```

```
@import "base-description";

.content-description {
    @include content-description;
}

// Flatpage shell (about / shop / custom pages). Presentation only — the stored
// markdown content is never altered (see docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md).
.flatpage-shell {
    max-width: var(--container-narrow, 960px);
    margin: 0 auto;

    // Branded title band at the top of the page.
    .flatpage-hero {
        background: var(--color-surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-left: 4px solid var(--color-accent);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-5);
        margin-bottom: var(--section-gap, 48px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);

        .flatpage-title {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: var(--text-2xl, 30px);
            font-weight: var(--weight-bold, 700);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            line-height: 1.15;
            color: var(--color-text);
        }
    }

    // Constrain prose to a comfortable reading measure; let tables/media breathe.
    .flatpage-body.content-description {
        line-height: 1.7;

        > p, > ul, > ol, > blockquote, > h1, > h2, > h3, > h4 {
            max-width: 72ch;
        }

        img {
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        }

        // Pricing/spec tables in flatpages get the modern token treatment.
        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            margin: var(--space-5) 0;
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            overflow: hidden;

            th, td {
                padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
                text-align: left;
            }

            thead th {
                background: var(--color-navbar);
                color: var(--color-text-inverse);
                font-weight: var(--weight-semibold, 600);
            }

            tbody tr:last-child td {
                border-bottom: 0;
            }

            tbody tr:nth-child(2n) td {
                background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            }

            tbody tr {
                transition: background-color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease);
            }

            tbody tr:hover td {
                background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Shop-specific: pricing tables read as emphasized tiers.
.flatpage-shop {
    .flatpage-body.content-description table tbody tr:hover td {
        background: var(--color-accent-2-soft, var(--color-surface-alt));
    }
}

.display-math {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}

@media (min-width: 700px) {
    #common-content {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row-reverse;
    }

    #content-left {
        flex: 5;
        width: 100%;

        &.split-common-content {
            width: 70%;
        }

        .content-description {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    #content-right {
        flex: 1;
        max-width: 14em;
        padding-left: 1.5em;
        padding-top: 1em;

        .info-float {
            float: none;
            padding: var(--space-4);
            position: sticky;
            top: 70px;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            background: var(--color-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
        }
    }
}

@media not all and (min-width: 700px) {
    #content-right .info-float {
        float: none;
        width: 100% !important;
        position: static !important;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }
}

a.view-pdf {
    padding-top: 0.6em;
    display: inline-block;
}

.problem-title {
    display: -webkit-box;
    display: -webkit-flex;
    display: -ms-flexbox;

}

.info-float .fa {

    padding-right: 0.2em;
}

#problem-types, #allowed-langs {
    .toggled {
        margin-left: 1.3em;
    }
}
```

```
    max-width: 430px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    box-sizing: border-box;

    // Register form is wider (more fields).
    &.auth-card--wide {
        max-width: 640px;
    }
}

.auth-card__header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-5);

    img.auth-logo {
        width: 52px;
        height: 52px;
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .auth-title {
        margin: var(--space-3) 0 var(--space-1);
        font-size: var(--text-xl);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .auth-subtitle {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }
}

.auth-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);

    .auth-field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-1);
    }

    label {
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }

    input[type="text"],
    input[type="password"],
    input[type="email"] {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    // Full-width primary action.
    .auth-submit {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: var(--space-1);
    }
}

.auth-footer {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    a {
        color: var(--color-link);
    }
}

// "or continue with" divider.
.auth-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: var(--space-5) 0 var(--space-4);
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    &::before,
    &::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        height: 1px;
        background: var(--color-border);
    }
}

// OAuth provider buttons.
.auth-oauth {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-2);

    .oauth-btn {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: var(--space-2);
        padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        background: var(--color-surface);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
            border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

        &:hover {
            background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        }

        &:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }

        i {
            font-size: 1.2em;
        }
    }
}
```

```
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title_row %}{% endblock %}
{% block title_ruler %}{% endblock %}

{% block body %}
    <div class="auth-page">
        <div class="auth-card">
            <div class="auth-brand">
                <img src="{{ static('icons/logo.svg') }}" alt="{{ SITE_NAME }}" width="48" height="48"
                     onerror="this.src='{{ static('icons/logo.png') }}'; this.onerror=null">
                <h1 class="auth-title">{{ _('Sign in to %(sitename)s', sitename=SITE_NAME) }}</h1>
            </div>

            {% if form.errors %}
                <div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                    <p>{{ _('Invalid username or password.') }}</p>
                    {% for error in form.non_field_errors() %}
                        <p>{{ error }}</p>
                    {% endfor %}
                    {% if misc_config.discord_invite_link and misc_config.discord_invite_shieldio %}
                        <p>{{ _('If you have problems with your account, feel free to shoot us a message at: ') }}
                            <a href="{{ misc_config.discord_invite_link }}">
                                <img src="{{ misc_config.discord_invite_shieldio }}" alt="Discord"></a>
                        </p>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            <form action="" method="post" class="auth-form">
                {% csrf_token %}
                <div class="auth-field">
                    <label for="id_username">{{ _('Username') }}</label>
                    <div class="auth-input">
                        <i class="fa fa-user fa-fw" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        {{ form.username }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="auth-field">
                    <label for="id_password">{{ _('Password') }}</label>
                    <div class="auth-input">
                        <i class="fa fa-key fa-fw" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        {{ form.password }}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <button class="auth-submit full" type="submit">{{ _('Login!') }}</button>
                <input type="hidden" name="next" value="{{ next }}">
            </form>

            <div class="auth-links">
                <a href="{{ url('password_reset') }}">{{ _('Forgot your password?') }}</a>
                {% if REGISTRATION_OPEN %}
                    <a href="{{ url('registration_register') }}">{{ _('Create an account') }}</a>
                {% endif %}
            </div>

            {% include "registration/oauth.html" %}
        </div>
    </div>
{% endblock %}

```

```
@import "vars";

// Auth pages (login / register / password reset). Centered card on the page
// canvas with real stacked fields, per docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md
// §3.2. Consumes semantic tokens so both palettes/themes stay in sync.

.auth-page {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-4) var(--space-8);
}

.auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 430px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    box-sizing: border-box;

    // Register form is wider (more fields).
    &.auth-card--wide {
        max-width: 640px;
    }
}

.auth-card__header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-5);

    img.auth-logo {
        width: 52px;
        height: 52px;
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .auth-title {
        margin: var(--space-3) 0 var(--space-1);
        font-size: var(--text-xl);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .auth-subtitle {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }
}

.auth-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);

    .auth-field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-1);
    }

    label {
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
```

```
@import "vars";

// Auth pages (login / register / password reset). Centered card on the page
// canvas with real stacked fields, per docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md
// §3.2. Consumes semantic tokens so both palettes/themes stay in sync.

.auth-page {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-4) var(--space-8);
}

.auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 430px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    box-sizing: border-box;

    // Register form is wider (more fields).
    &.auth-card--wide {
        max-width: 640px;
    }
}

.auth-card__header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-5);

    img.auth-logo {
        width: 52px;
        height: 52px;
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .auth-title {
        margin: var(--space-3) 0 var(--space-1);
        font-size: var(--text-xl);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .auth-subtitle {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }
}

.auth-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);

    .auth-field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-1);
    }

    label {
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }

    input[type="text"],
    input[type="password"],
    input[type="email"] {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    // Full-width primary action.
    .auth-submit {
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: var(--space-1);
    }
}

.auth-footer {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    a {
        color: var(--color-link);
    }
}

// "or continue with" divider.
.auth-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: var(--space-5) 0 var(--space-4);
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    &::before,
    &::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        height: 1px;
        background: var(--color-border);
    }
}

// Registration page: wrap the existing multi-field form in a centered card for
// visual consistency with login, without restructuring its fields.
#center-float {
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: var(--space-6) auto var(--space-8);

    #edit-form.form-area {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        background: var(--color-surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        padding: var(--space-6);
    }

    .block-header {
        color: var(--color-text) !important;
    }
}

// OAuth provider buttons.
.auth-oauth {
    margin-top: var(--space-2);
}

.auth-oauth-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-2);
}

.auth-oauth-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: var(--space-2);
    padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);

    background: var(--color-surface);

    transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),

        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    i {
        font-size: 1.2em;
    }

    &.oauth-google i {
        color: #dd4b38;
    }

    &.oauth-facebook i {
        color: #1877f2;
    }

    &.oauth-github i {
        color: var(--color-text);
    }
}
```

```
<script src="{{ static('libs/tablesorter.js') }}" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function () {
        var table = $("#judge-status");
        table.tablesorter();

        var tooltip_classes = 'tooltipped tooltipped-w';
        var active_judge = null;
        var active_lang = null;

        function display_tooltip(where) {
            where.addClass(tooltip_classes).attr('aria-label', where.attr('data-runtime-info'));
        }

        function install_tooltips() {
            $('.runtime-label').each(function () {
                var link = $(this);
                link.mouseenter(function (e) {
                    active_judge = link.attr('data-judge');
                    active_lang = link.attr('data-lang');
                    display_tooltip(link);
                }).mouseleave(function (e) {
                    active_judge = active_lang = null;
                    link.removeClass(tooltip_classes).removeAttr('aria-label');
                });
            });
        }

        var outdated = false;

        function update_table() {
            if ($('body').hasClass('window-hidden'))
                return outdated = true;
            $.ajax({
                url: '{{ url('status_table') }}'
            }).done(function (data) {
                // Readd the tooltip classes to minimize flicker on update
                var new_node = $(data);

                if (active_lang && active_judge) {
                    var selected = new_node.find('[data-judge=' + active_judge + '][data-lang=' + active_lang + ']');
                    if (selected) // Might have been removed, when a judge disconnected
                        display_tooltip(selected);
                }

                table.html(new_node);
                install_tooltips();
            }).always(function () {
                outdated = false;
                setTimeout(update_table, 10000);
            });
        }

        $(window).on('dmoj:window-visible', function () {
            if (outdated)
                update_table();
        });

        setTimeout(update_table, 10000);
        install_tooltips();
    });

// Verdict / status badges. Colors come from the protected verdict-token layer
// (docs/design-system/03-design-tokens.md §2.3): solid-fill background with a
// contrasting label, replacing the legacy grey-fill + colored-text. Semantics are
// unchanged (AC green, WA red, ...); the token values are theme-aware so badges
// stay legible on warm paper (light) and warm charcoal (dark) surfaces.
//
// Color is always paired with the verdict abbreviation text (never color-only) for
// accessibility (see 07-accessibility.md, spec 5.4).

.AB {
    background-color: var(--verdict-ab-bg);
    color: var(--verdict-ab-fg);
}

.AC {
    background-color: var(--verdict-ac-bg);
    color: var(--verdict-ac-fg);
}

}

}
```

```
}

}

}

// Judges page — responsive card grid (docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md
// §3.5). Replaces the legacy judge-status table; the #judge-status container is
// kept so the 10s AJAX refresh in status/media-js.html keeps working.
#judge-status {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
}

.judge-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-3);

    &__head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    &__name {
        font-size: var(--text-md);
        font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        word-break: break-word;
    }

    &__stats {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    &__runtimes {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-2);
    }
}

.judge-stat {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;

    &__label {
        font-size: var(--text-xs);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        color: var(--color-text-muted);
    }

    &__value {
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
}

// Online/offline status pill — pairs color with a text label (never color-only).
.judge-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-1);
    padding: 2px var(--space-2);
    border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    white-space: nowrap;

    .fa {
        font-size: 0.7em;
    }

    &--online {
        background: var(--color-success-bg);
        color: var(--color-success-fg);
    }

    &--offline {
        background: var(--color-danger-bg);
        color: var(--color-danger-fg);
    }
}

.judge-runtime-chips {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-1);

    .runtime-label {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: 2px var(--space-2);
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
        background: var(--color-surface-alt);
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        color: var(--color-link);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

        &:hover {
            background: var(--color-surface);
            border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        }
    }
}

.judge-empty {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-4);

    .fa {
        font-size: 2.5em;
        margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
        opacity: 0.5;
    }
}
```

```
<script src="{{ static('libs/tablesorter.js') }}" type="text/javascript"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">
    $(document).ready(function () {
        var table = $("#judge-status");
        // #judge-status is now a card grid (not a table); tablesorter no longer applies.

        var tooltip_classes = 'tooltipped tooltipped-w';
        var active_judge = null;
        var active_lang = null;

        function display_tooltip(where) {
            where.addClass(tooltip_classes).attr('aria-label', where.attr('data-runtime-info'));
        }

        function install_tooltips() {
            $('.runtime-label').each(function () {
                var link = $(this);
                link.mouseenter(function (e) {
                    active_judge = link.attr('data-judge');
                    active_lang = link.attr('data-lang');
                    display_tooltip(link);
                }).mouseleave(function (e) {
                    active_judge = active_lang = null;
                    link.removeClass(tooltip_classes).removeAttr('aria-label');
                });
            });
        }

        var outdated = false;

        function update_table() {
            if ($('body').hasClass('window-hidden'))
                return outdated = true;
            $.ajax({
                url: '{{ url('status_table') }}'
            }).done(function (data) {
                // Readd the tooltip classes to minimize flicker on update
                var new_node = $(data);

                if (active_lang && active_judge) {
                    var selected = new_node.find('[data-judge=' + active_judge + '][data-lang=' + active_lang + ']');
                    if (selected) // Might have been removed, when a judge disconnected
                        display_tooltip(selected);
                }

                table.html(new_node);
                install_tooltips();
            }).always(function () {
                outdated = false;
                setTimeout(update_table, 10000);
            });
        }

        $(window).on('dmoj:window-visible', function () {
            if (outdated)
                update_table();
        });

        setTimeout(update_table, 10000);
        install_tooltips();
    });
</script>
```

```
@import "vars";

// Home hero band (Phase 6c, docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md §3.1). The
// autumn artwork (A-1) fills the background via the --hero-image token and collapses
// gracefully to the accent gradient when no asset is set.
.home-hero {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
    padding: clamp(var(--space-5), 5vw, var(--space-8)) clamp(var(--space-4), 4vw, var(--space-7));
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-hover));
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);

    &--compact {
        padding: clamp(var(--space-4), 3vw, var(--space-6)) clamp(var(--space-4), 4vw, var(--space-7));
    }

    &__bg {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: var(--hero-image, none);
        background-size: cover;
        background-position: center;
        // Scrim keeps text AA-legible over whatever art lands.
        &::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
        }
    }

    &__content {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        max-width: 40rem;
    }

    &__title {
        font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        line-height: 1.15;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        margin: 0 0 var(--space-2);
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }

    &__pitch {
        font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.2rem);
        margin: 0 0 var(--space-4);
        opacity: 0.95;
    }

    &__actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: var(--space-3);
        margin-bottom: var(--space-5);

        .button {
            display: inline-block;
            width: auto;
        }

        // Secondary CTA reads as a translucent glass button on the accent band.
        .btn-secondary {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            color: var(--color-accent-contrast) !important;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);

            &:hover {
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
            }
        }
    }

    &__stats {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: clamp(var(--space-4), 4vw, var(--space-7));
    }
}

.hero-stat {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    &__value {
        font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2rem);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        line-height: 1.1;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    &__label {
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        opacity: 0.9;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .home-hero__stats {
        gap: var(--space-4);
    }
}

.blog-content {
    padding-right: 0em;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    vertical-align: top;

    .post {
        margin: 0em 0.5em;

        &:first-child {
            margin-top: 1.1em;
        }

        &:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1.7em;

            a {
                // Match the page title color (#content .title) so post titles read
                // as headings, not links. Palette-aware: sienna in Warm Harvest,
                // green in Summer.
                color: $color_primary75;

                &:hover {
                    color: var(--color-accent);
                }

                &:active {
                    color: $color_link200;
                }

                &:focus-visible {
                    outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
                    outline-offset: 2px;
                }
            }
        }

        .comment-count {
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .comment-count-link {
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        }

        .comment-icon {
            padding: 0 0.2em 0 0.5em;
        }

        .blog-body {
            border-left: 4px solid var(--color-border);
            margin: 1em 0;
            padding-left: 1em;
            padding-bottom: 0.25em;
        }
    }

    .meta {
        margin: 1em 0 1.5em 0;
        padding: 0.25em 0.5em;
        border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: 4px;
    }
}

.blog-sidebar {
    flex: 0 0 250px;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
}

.blog-sidebox {
    .leaderboard-content {
        padding: 0 !important;
        border: 0 !important;
    }

    .leaderboard-table {
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.02);
        border-radius: 0;

        th, td {
            transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
            border-radius: 0;
        }

        th {
            border-bottom-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        }

        .leaderboard-rank {
            width: 2.4rem;
            padding: 4px 9px !important;
            border-top-left-radius: 0;
        }

        .leaderboard-value {
            border-top-right-radius: 0;
        }

        // The outer table now owns the left border, avoiding gaps when the first column is hidden.
        th:first-child,
        td:first-child {
            border-left-width: 0;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td {
            background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.03);
        }

        tbody tr:hover td {
            background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.08);
        }

        tbody tr:first-child td {
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        td.user-contrib,
        td.user-points {
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
    }

    .leaderboard-footer-wrap {
        position: relative;
        font-size: smaller;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .leaderboard-footer {
        margin-top: -1px;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.02);
        border-radius: 0;

        td {
            padding: 0.5em 0.6em;
            background: transparent;
            border-radius: 0;
        }

        a {
            font-weight: 600;
        }
    }

    .users-table {
        table-layout: fixed;
        width: 100%;

        td,
        th {
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        td.user-name {
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;

            div {
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
            }
        }
    }

    ul {
        list-style: none;
        padding-left: 1em;
        padding-right: 0.5em;

        li {
            margin-bottom: 0.75em;
        }
    }

    .contest {
        display: grid;
        justify-items: center;
        gap: 0.25rem;
        padding: 0.85rem 0.25rem 1rem;
        text-align: center;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);

        &:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .contest-list-title {
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
            line-height: 1.25;

            a {
                // Match the brand heading color (like blog post titles) so sidebar
                // contest titles read as headings, not generic links. Palette-aware.
                color: $color_primary75;
                font-weight: 600;

                &:hover {
                    color: var(--color-accent);
                }

                &:focus-visible {
                    outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
                    outline-offset: 2px;
                }
            }
        }

        .time {
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
    }

    .sidebox-ongoing-contest {
        overflow-y: auto;
        max-height: none;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 800px) {

    .blog-content,
    .blog-sidebar {
        display: block !important;
    }

    .blog-content {
        margin-right: 1em;
    }

    #mobile.tabs {
        display: none;
    }

    #blog-container {
        display: flex;
        max-width: 100%;
        overflow: hidden;
    }
}

#mobile.tabs {
    margin: 0 0 1em;
}

.rssatom {
    text-align: right;
    margin: 0.25em;
    display: block;

    span {
        width: 1em;
        height: 1em;
        padding: 0.1em;
        font-size: 0.8em;
        color: white;
        border-radius: 0.2em;
        display: inline-block;
        margin-right: 0.2em;
        border: 1px solid rgb(201, 90, 18);
        background: #fb9e39;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e46d27 0, #fb9e39 47%, #e46d27 100%);

        i {
            text-align: center;
            display: block;
        }
    }
}

.open-tickets {
    .object {
        margin-left: 1em;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .author {
        margin-left: 1em;
    }
}
```

```
# 06 — Implementation Roadmap & Task List

Incremental, low-risk rollout. Each phase is independently shippable and leaves the
site fully functional. Check items off as they land. Phases map to the milestones
in `02-requirements.md`.

Legend: `[ ]` todo · `[~]` in progress · `[x]` done.

---

## Phase 0 — Foundations (no visual change)

Goal: stand up the token layer and tooling without altering the current look.

- [x] Create `resources/_tokens.scss` defining the semantic tokens as CSS custom
      properties (see `03-design-tokens.md`).
- [x] Emit tokens as CSS custom properties on `:root`, conditional on
      `$is_light_theme` so each compiled theme emits its own values (Approach A).
- [x] Wire `_tokens.scss` into `style.scss` before other partials (import order).
- [x] Add the two new semantic aliases `--color-accent-2` (secondary/gold accent)
      and `--color-surface-alt` (zebra/subtle panel) introduced in
      `08-autumn-theme.md`, so 03 and 08 agree. (see `03-design-tokens.md §2.2`)
- [~] Formalize the accessible `--verdict-*-bg` / `--verdict-*-fg` values from
      `03-design-tokens.md §2.3`. Deferred to Phase 3 (submission/status page work)
      where `resources/status.scss` is migrated; the token slots exist now.
- [x] Confirm `./make_style.sh` builds both default and dark cleanly; Phase 0
      tokens were additive with no visual diff.
- [x] Document the token workflow in this folder's README and cross-link.

Exit criteria: build is green, site looks identical, tokens available for use.

---

## Phase 1 — Theme delivery via `data-theme`

Goal: make dark mode a runtime attribute switch, remove FOUC, keep fallback.

- [x] Add `data-palette` to `<html>` in `templates/base.html`, resolved from
      `request.profile.site_palette` via `template_context.site_theme`. (foundation
      for a future runtime `data-theme` switch)
- [~] Inline no-FOUC head script: deferred with the single-stylesheet Approach B
      migration; split-file `media`-query loading avoids the flash for now.
- [x] Keep `DMOJ_THEME_CSS` split-file loading working; palettes map through the
      new `DMOJ_THEME_PALETTE_CSS` while `DMOJ_THEME_CSS` stays the default.
- [x] Preserve the `test_site` permission gate for dark mode in `base.html`.
- [x] Ace/Martor themes untouched; still follow `Profile.resolved_ace_theme`.

Exit criteria: theme switches via attribute; system-preference path intact.

---

## Phase 1b — Warm Harvest palette as default

Goal: adopt the "Warm Harvest" autumn palette (`08-autumn-theme.md`) as the default
for both light and dark, while preserving the old palette as an opt-in. This is a
palette swap on top of the token layer, so no component markup changes.

- [x] Back up the current green/blue palette as a selectable **"Summer"** theme:
      `vars-summer-default.scss` / `vars-summer-dark.scss` snapshot today's values,
      built to `resources/summer/` and selectable via `Profile.site_palette`.
- [x] Define the Warm Harvest primitives (`08 §2`: warm neutrals, sienna, gold,
      teal) in `vars-default.scss` / `vars-dark.scss` and point aliases at them.
- [x] Make Warm Harvest the **default** palette for both light and dark; a new
      `site_palette` field + `DMOJ_THEME_PALETTE_CSS` drive selection, defaulting
      to `warm`.
- [x] `--color-accent-2` (gold) and `--color-surface-alt` remap to gold / warm
      surfaces under Warm Harvest in `_tokens.scss`.
- [x] Enforce the **gold-is-not-body-text rule**: gold is used for accents only in
      the token layer, never body text.
- [~] Contrast verification against `07-accessibility.md §1` uses the pre-computed
      audit tables; live per-page verification lands with Phase 3 page work.

Exit criteria: Warm Harvest is the default in both modes, Summer selectable, all
semantic text pairs pass AA.

---

## Phase 2 — Core primitives

Goal: restyle the shared building blocks used on every page.

- [x] Navbar (`navbar.scss`, `base.html`): tokenize green/`#231F20`; add
      focus-visible; unify dropdowns. (spec 5.1)
- [x] Tokenize the impersonation navbar override: replace the inline `#893e89` in
      `templates/base.html` with a `--color-navbar-impersonate` token (spec 5.1),
      keeping the distinct color and FR-2.5 behavior.
- [x] Buttons (`widgets.scss`): implement variant system + states. (spec 5.2)
- [x] Links & focus rings globally (`base.scss`). (a11y)
- [x] Cards/surfaces primitives generalized from blog tokens. (spec 5.5)
- [x] Typography: introduce type scale + font tokens; load `Inter`/mono

Goal: apply the system to the pages users spend the most time on.

- [x] Problem statement (`problem.scss`, `content-description.scss`): info sidebar,

## Phase 4 — Long tail & polish

Goal: finish remaining surfaces and remove legacy artifacts.

- [x] Comments (`comments.scss`), tickets (`ticket.scss`): tokenized colors,
      borders, radii; focus-visible on interactive controls.
- [x] Blog: `blog.scss` migrated to shared link/border/surface tokens. (5.5)
- [x] Home page (`home.html`): hero artwork slot reserved (A-1); sidebox cards get
      token surface + radius + subtle elevation; contest-list titles match the brand
      heading color.
- [x] Retire redundant `$color_*` vars: migrated unambiguous border/surface/muted-text
      refs in the main-bundle partials to tokens. Aligned the Summer palette tokens to
      its classic legacy values first, verified both Summer builds keep their classic
      look (green count unchanged). Left as legacy by design: `rgba($color_*, ...)`
      calls (Sass needs a compile-time color), `$color_primary75` (palette-brand/widget
      color with no single semantic token), `$color_pageBg`/`$highlight_blue`/
      `$announcement_red` (protected vars), and the standalone-compiled
      `martor-description`/`ace-dmoj` files (no `:root` token layer).
- [x] Organization, stats, registration screens: no dedicated SCSS — inherit the
      already-tokenized shared components (tables, buttons, cards, forms). `misc.scss`
      tokenized.
- [x] Web fonts loaded: `Inter` (UI) + `JetBrains Mono` (code) via `font-display:
      swap`, prepended to the token stacks so type actually changes.
- [x] Warm Harvest uses a flat themed canvas (tiled photos already replaced in
      Phase 1 via `$flat_background`); Summer keeps its classic photos.
- [~] Accessibility: focus-visible + contrast-checked tokens applied; full manual
      AT pass still recommended per `07-accessibility.md`.
- [~] `status`/`task_status.css`: `status.scss` verdicts done (Phase 3);
      `task_status.css` left as a self-contained utility page.

Exit criteria: entire site on the system, legacy hex/backgrounds gone, a11y passes.

## Phase 5 — Visible modernization pass

Goal: move beyond "recolored" to a genuinely more modern, contemporary feel,
focusing on layout, depth, motion, and interaction polish. All token-driven and
applied to both palettes; verified no Summer drift.

- [x] Navbar: pill-style hover/active states, rounded dropdowns with soft shadow,
      smooth transitions, refined nav shadow.
- [x] Buttons: subtle hover-lift + shadow for depth (motion-guarded).
- [x] Inputs: larger padding, medium radius, soft focus-ring glow
      (`--color-focus-ring-soft` token added per palette).
- [x] Tables: rounded outer corners, softer header, animated row hover, lighter
      internal borders.
- [x] `#page-container` / `.title`: stronger heading hierarchy, contemporary
      elevation.
- [x] Global `prefers-reduced-motion` guard added (`base.scss`) for a11y.
- [x] Code blocks / problem info sidebar: card treatment (fallback-token pattern so
      the standalone martor build degrades gracefully).
- [x] User avatar, tabs, pagination, submission list, comment cards: modern radius,
      hover, and elevation polish.

Exit criteria: cohesive modern appearance across high-traffic pages, both palettes,
both themes; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected; no Summer regression.

Spec: `10-modern-ui-overhaul.md`. Page-level layout redesigns beyond tokenization.

- [x] 6a Foundations: layout tokens (`--container-max/-wide`, `--section-gap`,
      `--card-pad`), `_layout.scss` utilities (`.u-container`, `.u-grid-auto`,
      `.u-stack`, `.u-cluster`, `.section-head`), generalized `.card` family
      (`--interactive`/`--media`/`__title`/`__meta`/`__body`/`__footer`), and the

- [x] 6b Auth pages: `auth.scss` + redesigned `registration/login.html` (centered

- [x] 6c Home hero: `home.html` hero band with CTAs + live stat chips, logged-in

- [x] 6d Judges page → responsive card grid: `judge-status-table.html` renders

Exit criteria: home/auth/judges redesigned; about+shop modernized with content
intact; both palettes + themes correct; no Summer regression.
```

## The spec

I wrote `docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md` — a page-level redesign spec covering all the pages you named, grounded in the actual templates. Key architectural finding it captures: **`/shop/` and `/about/` are flatpages** (DB-stored markdown through one shared template), so they're redesigned by restyling the shell/renderer, never by touching your content.

## What shipped (4 phases, each built → verified → deployed)

**6a — Foundations:** layout tokens (`--container-max`, section gaps), a new `_layout.scss` (`.u-container`, `.u-grid-auto`, `.u-stack`), a generalized card family (`.card--interactive`, `.card__title/meta/body/footer`), and a **flatpage shell** that instantly modernized both about and shop (branded title header, constrained reading measure, upgraded tables, per-page body classes).

**6b — Auth pages:** login is now a centered card with a brand lockup, real labeled fields (not a `<table>`), icon affordances, inline `.alert` errors, a full-width submit, and OAuth provider buttons with an "or continue with" divider. Register + reset inherit the card shell.

**6c — Home hero:** a real hero band with headline, tagline, CTA buttons (Solve problems / Join a contest), and a live stat row (users / problems / submissions). Anonymous users get the marketing pitch; logged-in users get a compact "Welcome back" variant. The autumn artwork slot fills the background and degrades gracefully.

**6d — Judges page → cards:** replaced the table with a responsive card grid — each judge is a card with an online/offline **status pill** (semantic color + text label, not color-only), labeled Uptime/Ping/Load stats, and runtime chips. Critically, I **preserved the JS**: kept the `#judge-status` container and `.runtime-label` data attributes so the runtime popovers and 10s auto-refresh still work, and removed the now-irelevant `tablesorter()` call.

## Guardrails held
- **Content unchanged** on about/shop — presentation only, zero DB edits.
- **Summer intact** (green count 16) and **Warm Harvest** correct — verified every phase across all four builds.
- **Link color** confirmed sienna site-wide (`#c1440e`).
- **Accessibility** — status pills cary text labels, focus rings present, reduced-motion guard from phase 5 applies.
- **No new deps, no Python/migration changes.** Prod untouched (HTTP 200).

Home, login, judges, about, shop — all 200.

All committed on `feat/ui-phase-4-polish`.

- **Artwork** (hero image, logo, illustrations) still slots in later with no markup change.
