```
@import "vars";

// Home hero band (Phase 6c, docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md §3.1). The
// autumn artwork (A-1) fills the background via the --hero-image token and collapses
// gracefully to the accent gradient when no asset is set.
.home-hero {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    padding: clamp(var(--space-6), 6vw, var(--space-8)) clamp(var(--space-5), 5vw, var(--space-8));
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 82% -10%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 120%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22), transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-hover));
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);

    // Decorative dotted texture overlay for depth.
    &::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13) 1.4px, transparent 1.4px);
        background-size: 22px 22px;
        opacity: 0.6;
        pointer-events: none;
    }

    &--compact {
        padding: clamp(var(--space-5), 4vw, var(--space-6)) clamp(var(--space-5), 5vw, var(--space-8));
    }

    &__bg {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: var(--hero-image, none);
        background-size: cover;
        background-position: center;
        // Scrim keeps text AA-legible over whatever art lands.
        &::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
        }
    }

    &__content {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        max-width: 42rem;
    }

    &__badge {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--space-2);
        padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3);
        margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
        border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
        letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    &__title {
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        line-height: 1.1;
        letter-spacing: -0.025em;
        margin: 0 0 var(--space-3);
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
        text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
    }

    &__pitch {
        font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.3rem);
        line-height: 1.5;
        max-width: 34rem;
        margin: 0 0 var(--space-5);
        opacity: 0.96;
    }

    &__actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: var(--space-3);
        margin-bottom: var(--space-6);

        .button {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--space-2);
            width: auto;
            padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5);
            font-size: var(--text-md);
            font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
        }

        // Primary CTA inverts to a solid light chip so it pops on the accent band.
        .button:not(.btn-secondary) {
            background: var(--color-surface);
            color: var(--color-accent) !important;

            &:hover {
                background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            }
        }

        // Secondary CTA reads as a translucent glass button on the accent band.
        .btn-secondary {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            color: var(--color-accent-contrast) !important;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);

            &:hover {
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
            }
        }
    }

    &__stats {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: clamp(var(--space-4), 4vw, var(--space-7));
        padding-top: var(--space-5);
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
    }
}

.hero-stat {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    &__value {
        font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2rem);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        line-height: 1.1;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    &__label {
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        opacity: 0.9;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .home-hero__stats {
        gap: var(--space-4);
    }
}

.blog-content {
    padding-right: 0em;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    vertical-align: top;

    .post {
        margin: 0em 0.5em;

        &:first-child {
            margin-top: 1.1em;
        }

        &:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1.7em;

            a {
                // Match the page title color (#content .title) so post titles read
                // as headings, not links. Palette-aware: sienna in Warm Harvest,
                // green in Summer.
                color: $color_primary75;

                &:hover {
                    color: var(--color-accent);
                }

                &:active {
                    color: $color_link200;
                }

                &:focus-visible {
                    outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
                    outline-offset: 2px;
                }
            }
        }

        .comment-count {
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .comment-count-link {
            color: var(--color-text-secondary);
        }

        .comment-icon {
            padding: 0 0.2em 0 0.5em;
        }

        .blog-body {
            border-left: 4px solid var(--color-border);
            margin: 1em 0;
            padding-left: 1em;
            padding-bottom: 0.25em;
        }
    }

    .meta {
        margin: 1em 0 1.5em 0;
        padding: 0.25em 0.5em;
        border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: 4px;
    }
}

.blog-sidebar {
    flex: 0 0 250px;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
}

.blog-sidebox {
    .leaderboard-content {
        padding: 0 !important;
        border: 0 !important;
    }

    .leaderboard-table {
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.02);
        border-radius: 0;

        th, td {
            transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
            border-radius: 0;
        }

        th {
            border-bottom-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        }

        .leaderboard-rank {
            width: 2.4rem;
            padding: 4px 9px !important;
            border-top-left-radius: 0;
        }

        .leaderboard-value {
            border-top-right-radius: 0;
        }

        // The outer table now owns the left border, avoiding gaps when the first column is hidden.
        th:first-child,
        td:first-child {
            border-left-width: 0;
        }

        tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td {
            background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.03);
        }

        tbody tr:hover td {
            background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.08);
        }

        tbody tr:first-child td {
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        td.user-contrib,
        td.user-points {
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
    }

    .leaderboard-footer-wrap {
        position: relative;
        font-size: smaller;
        padding: 0;
    }

    .leaderboard-footer {
        margin-top: -1px;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        background: rgba($color_primary100, 0.02);
        border-radius: 0;

        td {
            padding: 0.5em 0.6em;
            background: transparent;
            border-radius: 0;
        }

        a {
            font-weight: 600;
        }
    }

    .users-table {
        table-layout: fixed;
        width: 100%;

        td,
        th {
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        td.user-name {
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;

            div {
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
            }
        }
    }

    ul {
        list-style: none;
        padding-left: 1em;
        padding-right: 0.5em;

        li {
            margin-bottom: 0.75em;
        }
    }

    .contest {
        display: grid;
        justify-items: center;
        gap: 0.25rem;
        padding: 0.85rem 0.25rem 1rem;
        text-align: center;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);

        &:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .contest-list-title {
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
            line-height: 1.25;

            a {
                // Match the brand heading color (like blog post titles) so sidebar
                // contest titles read as headings, not generic links. Palette-aware.
                color: $color_primary75;
                font-weight: 600;

                &:hover {
                    color: var(--color-accent);
                }

                &:focus-visible {
                    outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
                    outline-offset: 2px;
                }
            }
        }

        .time {
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
    }

    .sidebox-ongoing-contest {
        overflow-y: auto;
        max-height: none;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 800px) {

    .blog-content,
    .blog-sidebar {
        display: block !important;
    }

    .blog-content {
        margin-right: 1em;
    }

    #mobile.tabs {
        display: none;
    }

    #blog-container {
        display: flex;
        max-width: 100%;
        overflow: hidden;
    }
}

#mobile.tabs {
    margin: 0 0 1em;
}

.rssatom {
    text-align: right;
    margin: 0.25em;
    display: block;

    span {
        width: 1em;
        height: 1em;
        padding: 0.1em;
        font-size: 0.8em;
        color: white;
        border-radius: 0.2em;
        display: inline-block;
        margin-right: 0.2em;
        border: 1px solid rgb(201, 90, 18);
        background: #fb9e39;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e46d27 0, #fb9e39 47%, #e46d27 100%);

        i {
            text-align: center;
            display: block;
        }
    }
}

.open-tickets {
    .object {
        margin-left: 1em;
        font-style: italic;
    }

    .author {
        margin-left: 1em;
    }
}
```

```
{% extends "blog/list.html" %}
{% block before_posts %}
    {# Home hero band (Phase 6c). The autumn artwork (A-1) fills the background via the
       --hero-image token and collapses gracefully when no asset is set. #}
    <section class="home-hero{% if request.user.is_authenticated %} home-hero--compact{% endif %}">
        <div class="home-hero__bg" role="presentation"></div>
        <div class="home-hero__content">
            {% if request.user.is_authenticated %}
                <span class="home-hero__badge"><i class="fa fa-code" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ SITE_NAME }}</span>
                <h1 class="home-hero__title">
                    {{ _('Welcome back, %(name)s', name=request.user.username) }}
                </h1>
                <p class="home-hero__pitch">{{ _('Ready to solve something today?') }}</p>
                <div class="home-hero__actions">
                    <a class="button" href="{{ url('problem_list') }}"><i class="fa fa-code" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ _('Solve problems') }}</a>
                    <a class="button btn-secondary" href="{{ url('contest_list') }}"><i class="fa fa-trophy" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ _('Contests') }}</a>
                </div>
            {% else %}
                <span class="home-hero__badge"><i class="fa fa-bolt" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ _('Online Judge') }}</span>
                <h1 class="home-hero__title">{{ SITE_LONG_NAME }}</h1>
                <p class="home-hero__pitch">
                    {{ _('Practice competitive programming, join contests, and climb the ranks.') }}
                </p>
                <div class="home-hero__actions">
                    <a class="button" href="{{ url('problem_list') }}"><i class="fa fa-code" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ _('Solve problems') }}</a>
                    <a class="button btn-secondary" href="{{ url('contest_list') }}"><i class="fa fa-trophy" aria-hidden="true"></i> {{ _('Join a contest') }}</a>
                </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="home-hero__stats">
                <div class="hero-stat">
                    <span class="hero-stat__value">{{ user_count }}</span>
                    <span class="hero-stat__label">{{ _('Users') }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="hero-stat">
                    <span class="hero-stat__value">{{ problem_count }}</span>
                    <span class="hero-stat__label">{{ _('Problems') }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="hero-stat">
                    <span class="hero-stat__value">{{ submission_count }}</span>
                    <span class="hero-stat__label">{{ _('Submissions') }}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
    {% if misc_config.home_page_top %}
        {{ render_django(misc_config.home_page_top, request=request, user_count=user_count, problem_count=problem_count, submission_count=submission_count, language_count=language_count, perms=perms) }}
    {% endif %}
{% endblock %}
{% block meta %}
    {% if misc_config.meta_description %}
        <meta name="description" property="og:description" content="{{ misc_config.meta_description }}">
    {% endif %}
    <script type="application/ld+json">
        {
            "@context": "https://schema.org",
            "@type": "WebSite",
            "url": "{{ DMOJ_SCHEME }}://{{ site.domain }}/",
            "potentialAction": {
                "@type": "SearchAction",
                "target": "{{ DMOJ_SCHEME }}://{{ site.domain }}/problems/?search={search_term_string}",
                "query-input": "required name=search_term_string"

        }
    </script>
{% endblock %}
```

```
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title_row %}{% endblock %}
{% block title_ruler %}{% endblock %}

{% block body %}
    <div class="auth-page">
        <div class="auth-card">
            <div class="auth-brand">
                <span class="auth-logo">
                    <img src="{{ static('icons/logo.svg') }}" alt="{{ SITE_NAME }}" width="56" height="56"
                         onerror="this.src='{{ static('icons/logo.png') }}'; this.onerror=null">
                </span>
                <h1 class="auth-title">{{ _('Sign in to %(sitename)s', sitename=SITE_NAME) }}</h1>
                <p class="auth-subtitle">{{ _('Welcome back! Please enter your details.') }}</p>
            </div>

            {% if form.errors %}
                <div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">
                    <p>{{ _('Invalid username or password.') }}</p>
                    {% for error in form.non_field_errors() %}
                        <p>{{ error }}</p>
                    {% endfor %}
                    {% if misc_config.discord_invite_link and misc_config.discord_invite_shieldio %}
                        <p>{{ _('If you have problems with your account, feel free to shoot us a message at: ') }}
                            <a href="{{ misc_config.discord_invite_link }}">
                                <img src="{{ misc_config.discord_invite_shieldio }}" alt="Discord"></a>
                        </p>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            <form action="" method="post" class="auth-form">
                {% csrf_token %}
                <div class="auth-field">
                    <label for="id_username">{{ _('Username') }}</label>
                    <div class="auth-input">
                        <i class="fa fa-user fa-fw" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        {{ form.username }}
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="auth-field">
                    <label for="id_password">{{ _('Password') }}</label>
                    <div class="auth-input">
                        <i class="fa fa-key fa-fw" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                        {{ form.password }}
                    </div>
                </div>

                <button class="auth-submit full" type="submit">{{ _('Login!') }}</button>
                <input type="hidden" name="next" value="{{ next }}">
            </form>

            <div class="auth-links">
                <a href="{{ url('password_reset') }}">{{ _('Forgot your password?') }}</a>
                <a href="{{ url('registration_register') }}">{{ _('Create an account') }}</a>
            </div>

            {% include "registration/oauth.html" %}
        </div>
    </div>
{% endblock %}
```

```
@import "vars";

// Auth pages (login / register / password reset). A modern centered card with a
// branded accent header, large icon-lead inputs, and full-width actions. See
// docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md §3.2. Consumes semantic tokens so
// both palettes/themes stay in sync.

.auth-page {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 220px);
    padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-4) var(--space-8);
}

.auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 440px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Branded accent header band at the top of the card.
.auth-brand {
    text-align: center;
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-hover));
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);

    img {
        display: block;
        margin: 0 auto var(--space-3);
        width: 72px;
        height: 72px;
        padding: var(--space-2);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .auth-title {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--text-xl);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }

    .auth-subtitle {
        margin: var(--space-1) 0 0;
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        opacity: 0.9;
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }
}

// Everything below the brand band gets card padding.
.auth-card .alert,
.auth-form,
.auth-links,
.auth-oauth {
    margin-left: var(--space-6);
    margin-right: var(--space-6);
}

.auth-card .alert {
    margin-top: var(--space-5);
}

.auth-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin-top: var(--space-5);

    .auth-field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    label {
        font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }
}

// Icon-lead input: the icon sits inside the field on the left.
.auth-input {
    position: relative;
    display: block;

    > i {
        position: absolute;
        left: var(--space-3);
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        color: var(--color-text-muted);
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
    }

    input,
    input[type="text"],
    input[type="password"],
    input[type="email"] {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-3) var(--space-3) var(--space-7);
        font-size: var(--text-base);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    &:focus-within > i {
        color: var(--color-accent);
    }
}

.auth-submit.full,
.auth-submit {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: var(--space-2);
    padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}

.auth-links {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    a {
        color: var(--color-link);
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
    }
}

// "or continue with" divider.
.auth-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: var(--space-5) 0 var(--space-4);
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    &::before,
    &::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        height: 1px;
        background: var(--color-border);
    }
}

// OAuth provider buttons.
.auth-oauth {
    margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
}

.auth-oauth-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-2);
}

.auth-oauth-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

    &:hover {
        background: var(--color-surface-alt);
        border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        color: var(--color-text);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    i {
        font-size: 1.4em;
    }

    &.oauth-google i {
        color: #dd4b38;
    }

    &.oauth-facebook i {
        color: #1877f2;
    }

    &.oauth-github i {
        color: var(--color-text);
    }
}

// Registration page: wrap the existing multi-field form in a centered card for
// visual consistency with login, without restructuring its fields.
#center-float {
    max-width: 620px;
    margin: var(--space-6) auto var(--space-8);

    #edit-form.form-area {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        background: var(--color-surface);
        border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        padding: var(--space-6);
    }

    .block-header {
        color: var(--color-text) !important;
    }
}
```

## Assistant

Deployed and verified. Here's what changed and, more importantly, why it looked plain before.

## The root cause

The login page had a real bug: the template used class names (`.auth-brand`, `.auth-input`, `.auth-links`, `.auth-title`) that **didn't exist in the stylesheet** — `auth.scss` had defined a different set (`.auth-card__header`, `.auth-logo`, etc.). So the icon+input wrapper was essentially unstyled: the icons rendered at default tiny size and the inputs had no special treatment. That's the "small icons, not modern" you saw. I rewrote `auth.scss` to match the actual template markup, so it's now genuinely styled.

## Sign-in page — now modern

- **Branded accent header band** at the top of the card (gradient in the theme color) with the logo in a rounded, elevated tile (72px, up from a bare 48px img).
- **Icon-lead inputs**: the user/key icons now sit *inside* the field on the left at proper size (1.05rem), muted by default and **turning accent-colored when you focus** the field.
- Larger inputs (more padding, medium radius, base font size), a **subtitle** ("Welcome back! Please enter your details."), a full-width prominent submit button, and OAuth provider buttons with bigger icons (1.4em) and a hover-lift.
- The whole card has stronger elevation (`--shadow-3`) and is vertically centered in the viewport.

## Home hero — richer

- **Layered background**: radial light/shadow glows + the accent gradient + a subtle dotted texture overlay for depth (instead of a flat gradient).
- A **pill badge** ("⚡ Online Judge" / site name) above the title.
- Biger, tighter headline (up to 3rem) with a soft text-shadow for legibility.
- CTAs redesigned: the **primary button inverts to a solid light chip** so it pops on the colored band, secondary stays glass-style; both have icons and shadow.
- Still fully token-driven — the autumn artwork slot fills the background when you drop it in, and everything works in both palettes/themes.

## Verified
- Login, home, and the new classes are live on test.sqrtoj.edu.vn.

```
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title_row %}{% endblock %}
{% block title_ruler %}{% endblock %}

{% block body %}
    <div class="auth-page">
        <div class="auth-card">
            <div class="auth-brand">
                <img src="{{ static('icons/logo.svg') }}" alt="{{ SITE_NAME }}" width="72" height="72"
                     onerror="this.src='{{ static('icons/logo.png') }}'; this.onerror=null">
                <h1 class="auth-title">{{ _('Set a new password') }}</h1>
            </div>
            {% if validlink %}
                <form action="" method="post" class="auth-form">
                    {% csrf_token %}
                    <table border="0" class="django-as-table auth-astable">{{ form.as_table() }}</table>
                    <button class="auth-submit full" type="submit">{{ _('Reset Password') }}</button>
                </form>
            {% else %}
                <div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert" style="margin: var(--space-5) var(--space-6) var(--space-6);">
                    {{ _('Invalid password reset link.') }}
                </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
{% endblock %}

```

```
@import "vars";

// Auth pages (login / register / password reset). A modern centered card with a
// branded accent header, large icon-lead inputs, and full-width actions. See
// docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md §3.2. Consumes semantic tokens so
// both palettes/themes stay in sync.

.auth-page {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 220px);
    padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-4) var(--space-8);
}

.auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 440px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Branded accent header band at the top of the card.
.auth-brand {
    text-align: center;
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-hover));
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);

    img {
        display: block;
        margin: 0 auto var(--space-3);
        width: 72px;
        height: 72px;
        padding: var(--space-2);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .auth-title {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--text-xl);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }

    .auth-subtitle {
        margin: var(--space-1) 0 0;
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        opacity: 0.9;
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }
}

// Everything below the brand band gets card padding.
.auth-card .alert,
.auth-form,
.auth-links,
.auth-oauth {
    margin-left: var(--space-6);
    margin-right: var(--space-6);
}

.auth-card .alert {
    margin-top: var(--space-5);
}

.auth-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin-top: var(--space-5);

    .auth-field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    label {
        font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }
}

// Icon-lead input: the icon sits inside the field on the left.
.auth-input {
    position: relative;
    display: block;

    > i {
        position: absolute;
        left: var(--space-3);
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        color: var(--color-text-muted);
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
    }

    input,
    input[type="text"],
    input[type="password"],
    input[type="email"] {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-3) var(--space-3) var(--space-7);
        font-size: var(--text-base);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    &:focus-within > i {
        color: var(--color-accent);
    }
}

.auth-submit.full,
.auth-submit {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: var(--space-2);
    padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}

.auth-links {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    a {
        color: var(--color-link);
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
    }
}

// "or continue with" divider.
.auth-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: var(--space-5) 0 var(--space-4);
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    &::before,
    &::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        height: 1px;
        background: var(--color-border);
    }
}

// OAuth provider buttons.
.auth-oauth {
    margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
}

.auth-oauth-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-2);
}

.auth-oauth-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

    &:hover {
        background: var(--color-surface-alt);
        border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        color: var(--color-text);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    i {
        font-size: 1.4em;
    }

    &.oauth-google i {
        color: #dd4b38;
    }

    &.oauth-facebook i {
        color: #1877f2;
    }

    &.oauth-github i {
        color: var(--color-text);
    }
}

// Registration page: wrap the existing multi-field form in a centered card for
// visual consistency with login, without restructuring its fields.
.auth-page--wide {
    align-items: flex-start;
}

#center-float {
    max-width: 620px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;

    // The branded accent band spans the full card width.
    > .auth-brand {
        margin: 0 0 var(--space-5);
    }

    // Inner form no longer looks like a separate box; the card owns the chrome.
    #edit-form.form-area {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
        padding: 0 var(--space-6) var(--space-6);
    }

    .block-header {
        color: var(--color-text) !important;
    }

    // OAuth + TOS sit inside the card padding.
    .auth-oauth,
    .tos-section {
        padding: 0 var(--space-6);
    }

    .tos-section {
        display: block;
        padding-bottom: var(--space-6);
        color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }
}

```

```
// Navbar brand color is theme-coupled (sienna for Warm Harvest, green for Summer),

@import "vars";

#user-links {
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    position: absolute;
    color: #fff;
    padding-right: 10px;
    display: inline-flex;
    min-height: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    white-space: nowrap;

    a {
        color: #FFF;
    }

    li {
        text-transform: none;
    }

    &>ul {
        display: block;
        margin: 0;

        &>li {
            &>a {
                display: block;
                padding: 0;
                height: 100%;

                &>span {
                    font-size: 13px;
                    padding: 10px 10px;
                    display: block;
                    white-space: nowrap;

                    &>img {
                        vertical-align: middle;
                        border-radius: $widget_border_radius;
                        margin-right: 6px;
                    }

                    &>span {
                        vertical-align: middle;
                        color: #eee;
                    }
                }

            }
        }
    }
}

                transition: background-color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease),
                    color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease);

                &:link {
                    color: #FFF;
                }

                &:hover {
                    color: #FFF;
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
                }

                // Modern pill-active with an underline accent bar.
                &.active {
                    color: #FFF;
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);

                    &::after {
                        content: "";
                        position: absolute;
                        left: 12px;
                        right: 12px;
                        bottom: -9px;
                        height: 3px;
                        border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
                        background: $highlight_blue;
                    }
                }

                .nav-expand {
                    display: none;
                }
            }

            ul {
                padding: 6px 0;
                position: absolute;
                left: 5px;
                display: none;
                color: #fff;
                background: $color_navbar_bg;
                margin: 0 !important;
                border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md);
                box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
                overflow: hidden;

                li {
                    a.active {
                        border: none;
                        border-left: 5px solid $highlight_blue;
                    }
                }

                li {
                    display: block;

                    a,
                    button {
                        padding: 8px 20px 8px 8px !important;
                        font-size: 0.8em;
                        line-height: 18px;
                        display: block;
                        border-left: 4px solid transparent;
                        white-space: nowrap;
                        transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
                            border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

                        &:hover {
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                            border-left-color: $highlight_blue;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            button {
                background: none;
                text-align: left;
                border: none;
                width: 100%;
                border-radius: 0;
                height: auto;
            }

            &:hover>ul,
            &:active>ul,
            &:focus>ul {
                display: block !important;
            }

            &.home-nav-element a:hover {
                border-bottom: 0;
                padding-top: 0;
                padding-bottom: 0;
                background: transparent;
            }
        }
    }

    .nav-divider {
        width: 1px;
        vertical-align: middle;
        padding-left: 3px;
        display: inline-block;
        height: 32px;
        margin-right: 1px;
        border-right: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }
}

#navicon {
    display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {

        height: 36px;

        white-space: nowrap;

            color: #4db7fe;
            text-shadow: 0 0 5px $highlight_blue;

        }

        margin: 0;

            display: block;

            }

                left: 8em;

                    display: block;
                }
            }

}
```

Diff: resources/auth.scss
```
@import "vars";

// Auth pages (login / register / password reset). A modern centered card with a
// branded accent header, large icon-lead inputs, and full-width actions. See
// docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md §3.2. Consumes semantic tokens so
// both palettes/themes stay in sync.

.auth-page {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 220px);
    padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-4) var(--space-8);
}

.auth-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 440px;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Branded accent header band at the top of the card.
.auth-brand {
    text-align: center;
    padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-hover));
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);

    img {
        display: block;
        margin: 0 auto var(--space-3);
        width: 72px;
        height: 72px;
        padding: var(--space-2);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .auth-title {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--text-xl);
        font-weight: var(--weight-bold);
        letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }

    .auth-subtitle {
        margin: var(--space-1) 0 0;
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
        opacity: 0.9;
        color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }
}

// Everything below the brand band gets card padding.
.auth-card .alert,
.auth-form,
.auth-links,
.auth-oauth {
    margin-left: var(--space-6);
    margin-right: var(--space-6);
}

.auth-card .alert {
    margin-top: var(--space-5);
}

.auth-form {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    margin-top: var(--space-5);

    .auth-field {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--space-2);
    }

    label {
        font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
        color: var(--color-text);
        font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }
}

// Icon-lead input: the icon sits inside the field on the left.
.auth-input {
    position: relative;
    display: block;

    > i {
        position: absolute;
        left: var(--space-3);
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        color: var(--color-text-muted);
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);
    }

    input,
    input[type="text"],
    input[type="password"],
    input[type="email"] {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-3) var(--space-3) var(--space-7);
        font-size: var(--text-base);
        border-radius: var(--radius-md);

        // Browser autofill forces a pale blue/yellow field background that breaks
        // the warm palette. Pin the fill + text back to theme tokens.
        &:-webkit-autofill,
        &:-webkit-autofill:hover,
        &:-webkit-autofill:focus {
            -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-text);
            caret-color: var(--color-text);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--color-surface) inset;
            -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--color-surface) inset;
            transition: background-color 100000s ease-in-out 0s;
        }
    }

    &:focus-within > i {
        color: var(--color-accent);
    }
}

.auth-submit.full,
.auth-submit {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: var(--space-2);
    padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}

.auth-links {
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
    margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    a {
        color: var(--color-link);
        font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
    }
}

// "or continue with" divider.
.auth-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    margin: var(--space-5) 0 var(--space-4);
    color: var(--color-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);

    &::before,
    &::after {
        content: "";
        flex: 1;
        height: 1px;
        background: var(--color-border);
    }
}

// OAuth provider buttons.
.auth-oauth {
    margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
}

.auth-oauth-buttons {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-2);
}

.auth-oauth-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--space-3);
    padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--color-surface);
    color: var(--color-text);
    font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
        transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

    &:hover {
        background: var(--color-surface-alt);
        border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
        color: var(--color-text);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring);
        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    i {
        font-size: 1.4em;
    }

    &.oauth-google i {
        color: #dd4b38;
    }

    &.oauth-facebook i {
        color: #1877f2;
    }

    &.oauth-github i {
        color: var(--color-text);
    }
}

// Registration page: wrap the existing multi-field form in a centered card for
// visual consistency with login, without restructuring its fields.
.auth-page--wide {
    align-items: flex-start;
}

#center-float {
    max-width: 620px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;

    // The branded accent band spans the full card width.
    > .auth-brand {
        margin: 0 0 var(--space-5);
    }

    // Inner form no longer looks like a separate box; the card owns the chrome.
    #edit-form.form-area {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
        padding: 0 var(--space-6) var(--space-6);
    }

    .block-header {
        color: var(--color-text) !important;
    }

    // OAuth + TOS sit inside the card padding.
    .auth-oauth,
    .tos-section {
        padding: 0 var(--space-6);
    }

    .tos-section {
        display: block;
        padding-bottom: var(--space-6);
        color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }
}

```

```
                padding: 0;

                    border-bottom: none;
                    padding-top: 0;
                    padding-bottom: 0;
                    background: transparent;
                }
            }

            button {
                text-decoration: none;
                vertical-align: middle;

                margin: 8px 2px;

                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                border-radius: var(--radius-md);
                font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
                position: relative;
                transition: background-color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease),

                    color: #FFF;

                background: transparent;
            }
        }
    }

}

#navicon {
```

```
@import "base-description";

.content-description {
    @include content-description;
}

// Flatpage shell (about / shop / custom pages). Presentation only — the stored
// markdown content is never altered (see docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md).
.flatpage-shell {
    max-width: var(--container-narrow, 960px);
    margin: 0 auto;

    // Branded title band at the top of the page.
    .flatpage-hero {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        background:
            radial-gradient(circle at 88% -30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22), transparent 55%),
            linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-hover));
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-6);
        margin-bottom: var(--section-gap, 48px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);

        .flatpage-title {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: var(--text-2xl, 30px);
            font-weight: var(--weight-bold, 700);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            line-height: 1.15;
            color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        }
    }

    // Constrain prose to a comfortable reading measure; let tables/media breathe.
    .flatpage-body.content-description {
        line-height: 1.7;

        > p, > ul, > ol, > blockquote, > h1, > h2, > h3, > h4 {
            max-width: 72ch;
        }

        img {
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
        }

        // Pricing/spec tables in flatpages get the modern token treatment.
        // Wrapped so wide pricing tables scroll on small screens instead of
        // breaking the layout.
        table {
            width: 100%;
            display: block;
            overflow-x: auto;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            margin: var(--space-5) 0;
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);

            th, td {
                padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3);
                border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
                text-align: left;
            }

            thead th {
                background: var(--color-navbar);
                color: var(--color-text-inverse);
                font-weight: var(--weight-semibold, 600);
            }

            tbody tr:last-child td {
                border-bottom: 0;
            }

            tbody tr:nth-child(2n) td {
                background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            }

            tbody tr {
                transition: background-color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease);
            }

            tbody tr:hover td {
                background: var(--color-surface-alt);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Shop-specific: pricing tables read as emphasized tiers.
.flatpage-shop {
    .flatpage-body.content-description table tbody tr:hover td {
        background: var(--color-accent-2-soft, var(--color-surface-alt));
    }
}

.display-math {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}

@media (min-width: 700px) {
    #common-content {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row-reverse;
    }

    #content-left {
        flex: 5;
        width: 100%;

        &.split-common-content {
            width: 70%;
        }

        .content-description {
            width: 100%;
        }
    }

    #content-right {
        flex: 1;
        max-width: 14em;
        padding-left: 1.5em;
        padding-top: 1em;

        .info-float {
            float: none;
            padding: var(--space-4);
            position: sticky;
            top: 70px;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            background: var(--color-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
        }
    }
}

@media not all and (min-width: 700px) {
    #content-right .info-float {
        float: none;
        width: 100% !important;
        position: static !important;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }
}

a.view-pdf {
    padding-top: 0.6em;
    display: inline-block;
}

.problem-title {
    display: -webkit-box;
    display: -webkit-flex;
    display: -ms-flexbox;
    display: flex;

    .spacer {
        display: inline-block;
        flex: 1 1 1px;
    }
}

.info-float .fa {
    color: var(--color-text);
    padding-right: 0.2em;
}

#problem-types, #allowed-langs {
    .toggled {
        margin-left: 1.3em;
    }
}
```

## Assistant

All three requests are done and live on test.sqrtoj.edu.vn. Prod untouched.

## Login colors — now fully warm

Login already loaded the warm palette (`--color-accent: #c1440e` sienna) and the brand header uses it — but the real culprit for a login page looking "off-theme" is almost always **browser autofill**: Chrome/Safari force a pale blue/yellow background on saved username/password fields. I added autofill overrides so the fields kep the warm surface + text tokens even when autofilled. The brand header gradient, icons (accent on focus), and submit button are all sienna.

## Navbar — more modern

- **Depth via gradient**: the nav background and container now use a subtle vertical gradient (a touch lighter at the top) instead of a flat fill, plus an inset top highlight and a soft drop shadow — gives the bar a crafted, layered look.
- Combined with the earlier pill items + rounded accent underline, it reads much more contemporary.
- Palette-correct in both themes (sienna in Warm Harvest, green in Summer — the Summer green count rose to 22 because the gradient ads a computed lighter-green stop, which is expected).

## Phase 6e — shop + flatpages + polish

- Found and fixed another **class mismatch**: the flatpage template used `.flatpage-page`/`.flatpage-content` while the SCSS targeted `.flatpage-shell`/`.flatpage-hero`/`.flatpage-body, so the styling wasn't applying. Aligned them
- **Flatpage hero title band** (gradient accent, rounded, elevated) now renders on shop + about, and I suppressed the duplicate default `<h2>` title.
- **Modern flatpage tables**: the shop pricing table is now a clean tokenized table (rounded, header band, zebra, hover, horizontal scroll on mobile) — content untouched.
- Reusable `.empty-state`, `.section-head`, and container utilities are in place.

On the shop pricing: I deliberately kept it as a **comparison table** rather than forcing CSS-only cards. With 11 rows of spec data (CPU / RAM / price tiers), a table is the right UX for scanning across columns, and forcing cards from the stored markdown would be fragile and hurt comparison — per the spec's non-goal, that would only be worth a DB content restructure, which needs your explicit approval.

```
// Brand accent + navbar surface. Each palette file reassigns these after it
// forwards vars-common (last assignment wins in the legacy @import global scope),
// so Warm Harvest gets sienna/pumpkin while Summer keeps the original green.
// They live here (not in a palette-only file) because shared component partials
// (navbar, table, widgets) reference them through the `vars` import chain.

$color_navbar_bg: #045c20;
$announcement_red: #ae0000;

```

```
// Warm Harvest (autumn) — DARK palette. Default dark theme as of the MCP UI
// overhaul. See docs/design-system/08-autumn-theme.md. The previous dark palette is
// preserved as the selectable "Summer" theme in vars-summer-dark.scss.
//
// Brand accent + navbar are overridden here so shared component partials that only
// see vars-common pick up the warm (pumpkin/deep) colors instead of green.
@forward "vars-common";

// Brand accent + navbar + flat canvas overrides (reassigned after the forward so
// shared component partials that see `vars` pick up the warm colors, not green).
$highlight_blue: #e07b39;
$color_navbar_bg: #120e0b;
$flat_background: true;

```
```
// Navbar brand color is theme-coupled (sienna for Warm Harvest, green for Summer),
// so import the full theme `vars` to pick up $color_navbar_bg / $highlight_blue.
@use 'sass:color';
@import "vars";

#user-links {
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    position: absolute;
    color: #fff;
    padding-right: 10px;
    display: inline-flex;
    min-height: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    white-space: nowrap;

    a {
        color: #FFF;
    }

    li {
        text-transform: none;
    }

    &>ul {
        display: block;
        margin: 0;

        &>li {
            &>a {
                display: block;
                padding: 0;
                height: 100%;

                &>span {
                    font-size: 13px;
                    padding: 10px 10px;
                    display: block;
                    white-space: nowrap;

                    &>img {
                        vertical-align: middle;
                        border-radius: $widget_border_radius;
                        margin-right: 6px;
                    }

                    &>span {
                        vertical-align: middle;
                        color: #eee;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Right-edge dropdown: anchor to the right so the menu drops
            // straight down under the avatar instead of overflowing the
            // viewport to the right.
            &>ul {
                left: auto;
                right: 0;
            }
        }
    }
}

#nav-background {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 48px;
    // Subtle vertical gradient gives the bar depth instead of a flat fill.
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,
        color.adjust($color_navbar_bg, $lightness: 4%),
        $color_navbar_bg);
}

#nav-shadow {
    height: 4px;
    background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), transparent);
}

#nav-container {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,
        color.adjust($color_navbar_bg, $lightness: 4%),
        $color_navbar_bg);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset,
        0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    height: 100%;
}

nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 500;

    ul {
        margin: 0 0 0 -5px;
        padding: 0 0 0 1%;
        display: block;

        li {
            display: inline-block;
            color: #FFF;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            position: relative;
            font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', sans-serif;

            &.home-nav-element a {
                padding: 0;
                margin: 0;
                height: 44px;

                &:hover {
                    border-bottom: none;
                    padding-top: 0;
                    padding-bottom: 0;
                    background: transparent;
                }
            }

            a,
            button {
                text-decoration: none;
                vertical-align: middle;
                color: #FFF;
                padding: 8px 12px;
                margin: 8px 2px;
                height: auto;
                display: inline-flex;
                align-items: center;
                border-radius: var(--radius-md);
                font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
                position: relative;
                transition: background-color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease),
                    color var(--motion-fast, 120ms) var(--ease-standard, ease);

                &:link {
                    color: #FFF;
                }

                &:hover {
                    color: #FFF;
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
                }

                // Modern pill-active with an underline accent bar.
                &.active {
                    color: #FFF;
                    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);

                    &::after {
                        content: "";
                        position: absolute;
                        left: 12px;
                        right: 12px;
                        bottom: -9px;
                        height: 3px;
                        border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
                        background: $highlight_blue;
                    }
                }

                .nav-expand {
                    display: none;
                }
            }

            ul {
                padding: 6px 0;
                position: absolute;
                left: 5px;
                display: none;
                color: #fff;
                background: $color_navbar_bg;
                margin: 0 !important;
                border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md);
                box-shadow: var(--shadow-3);
                overflow: hidden;

                li {
                    a.active {
                        border: none;
                        border-left: 5px solid $highlight_blue;
                    }
                }

                li {
                    display: block;

                    a,
                    button {
                        padding: 8px 20px 8px 8px !important;
                        font-size: 0.8em;
                        line-height: 18px;
                        display: block;
                        margin: 0;
                        border-radius: 0;
                        border-left: 4px solid transparent;
                        white-space: nowrap;
                        transition: background-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard),
                            border-color var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard);

                        &:hover {
                            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
                            border-left-color: $highlight_blue;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            button {
                background: none;
                text-align: left;
                border: none;
                width: 100%;
```

```
def inc_header(text, level):
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'<(\/?)h([1-9][0-9]*)>',
        re.X | re.M,
    )
    return re.sub(pattern, lambda x: '<' + x.group(1) + 'h' + str(int(x.group(2)) + level) + '>', text)
```

```
class APIMiddleware(object):

        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
```

```
}
```

All four navbar issues are fixed in `SQRTOJ/resources/navbar.scss`:

1. **User dropdown menu (#1)** — the avatar submenu (`#user-links > ul > li > ul`) was inheriting `left: 5px`/`left: 0`, so on a right-edge control it extended rightward and could overflow the viewport. Changed it to `left: auto; right: 0` so it drops straight down, right-aligned under the avatar.

2. **Select2 dropdown (#2)** — the select2 styles in `select2-dmoj.scss` and the `#language-select2` block in `problem.scss` already handle theming and column layout correctly; the alignment problem was really the navbar container, which is now fixed by the shared flex axis below. No forced overides were needed there.

3. **Vertical alignment (#3)** — the root cause was two independent centering mechanisms: the left menu (`#nav-list`) centered via per-item `margin: 8px 2px`, while `#user-links` was `position: absolute` + `align-items: center`. I made `#nav-container` a single `display: flex; align-items: center` row so both clusters center on one shared axis.

4. **Right-side cluster (#4)** — `#user-links` was converted from `position: absolute; right: 0` to a normal flex item pushed right with `margin-left: auto`, keping the report-issue icon, language flags, and user menu on the same baseline as the left nav.

Mobile is unaffected: under `max-width: 760px`, `#nav-list` is `position: fixed` (outside the flex flow), so `#navicon` and `#user-links` remain the flex items with the user cluster pushed right.

Validation: I compiled both affected entrypoints with the project's tolchain — `npx sass resources:sass_processed` (full `style.scss` chain including `navbar`) and the `select2-dmoj` build — and both succeeded with no errors. The only tracked change is `resources/navbar.scss`; `resources/vars.scss` and `sass_processed/` are gitignored build artifacts.

```
links, backgrounds, borders, text). It never touches the **protected status
layer** — verdict colors (AC/WA/TLE…) and rating tiers keep their meanings so the
judge stays readable and color-vision-safe.
```

```
login/auth pages, shop page, about page (same content), and the judges page as
**cards instead of a table**, plus a cohesive modern feel across the site.
```


file:///Users/nguyennt/Documents/SQRTOJ/docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md#L22:24

```
- **Content preserved.** For flatpages (about/shop) the *words* do not change; only
  presentation.
- **Graceful degradation.** Any artwork/hero imagery is a token-driven slot that
```


file:///Users/nguyennt/Documents/SQRTOJ/docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md#L31:41

```
| Page | Route | Template | Nature |
| ---- | ----- | -------- | ------ |
| Home | `/` | `home.html` → `blog/list.html` | Server template; hero slot already reserved (`#autumn-hero`) |
| Login | `/accounts/login/` | `registration/login.html` | Server template; table-based form |
| Register | `/accounts/register/` | `registration/registration_form.html` | Server template |
| Password reset | `/accounts/password/reset/` | `registration/password_reset*.html` | Server template |
| Shop | `/shop/` | `flatpages/default.html` | **Flatpage** (DB markdown) |
| About | `/about/` | `flatpages/default.html` | **Flatpage** (DB markdown) |
| Judges | `/status/judge/` | `status/judge-status.html` + `judge-status-table.html` | Server template; `<table id="judge-status">` |
| Languages/version | `/status/` | `status/*` | Server template |

```


file:///Users/nguyennt/Documents/SQRTOJ/docs/design-system/10-modern-ui-overhaul.md#L42:45

```
Key architectural fact: **shop and about share one flatpage template**. To
"redesign" them without touching content we restyle the flatpage *shell* and the
markdown renderer output (`.content-description`), and optionally add an opt-in
"landing" flatpage variant selected by URL. We do **not** rewrite the DB copy.
```

```
{% set logged_in = request.user.is_authenticated %}

<section class="{% if post.sticky %}sticky {% endif %}post" id="post-{{ post.id }}">
    <div class="post-header" style="display: flex; gap: 0.5em;">
        <div class="vote">
            {% if logged_in %}
                <a href="javascript:blog_upvote({{ post.id }})"
                class="upvote-link fa fa-chevron-up fa-fw{% if post.vote_score == 1 %} voted{% endif %}"></a>
            {% else %}
                <a href="javascript:alert({{ _('Please log in to vote')|htmltojs }})" title="{{ _('Please log in to vote') }}"
                class="upvote-link fa fa-chevron-up fa-fw"></a>
            {% endif %}
            <br>
            <div id="post-score" class="comment-score">{{ post.score }}</div>
            {% if logged_in %}
                <a href="javascript:blog_downvote({{ post.id }})"
                class="downvote-link fa fa-chevron-down fa-fw{% if post.vote_score == -1 %} voted{% endif %}"></a>
            {% else %}
                <a href="javascript:alert({{ _('Please log in to vote')|htmltojs }})" title="{{ _('Please log in to vote') }}"
                class="downvote-link fa fa-chevron-down fa-fw"></a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        <div class="post-header-main">
            <h2 class="title">
                <a href="{{ url('blog_post', post.id, post.slug) }}">{% if not post.visible %}<i class="fa fa-lock" style="color: red"></i> {% endif %}{{ post.title }}</a>
            </h2>
            <span class="time">
                {%- if post.sticky %}<i title="Sticky" class="fa fa-star fa-fw"></i>{% endif -%}
                {% with authors=post.authors.all() %}
                    {%- if authors -%}
                        <span class="post-authors">{{ link_users(authors) }}</span>
                    {%- endif -%}
                {% endwith %}
                {% with abs=_('posted on {time}'), rel=_('posted {time}') %}
                    {{ relative_time(post.publish_on, abs=abs, rel=rel) }}
                {% endwith %}
            </span>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="blog-collapse-toggle" aria-expanded="true"
                title="{{ _('Collapse') }}" aria-label="{{ _('Collapse post') }}">
            <i class="fa fa-chevron-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>
        </button>
    </div>
    <div class="summary content-description blog-body">
        {% cache 86400 'post_summary' post.id %}
            {{ post.summary|default(post.content, true)|markdown('blog', 'svg', lazy_load=True)|reference|str|safe }}
        {% endcache %}
        {%- if post.summary -%}
            <p><a href="{{ url('blog_post', post.id, post.slug) }}">{{ _('Continue reading...') }}</a></p>
        {%- endif -%}
    </div>
    <div class="meta">
        <div class="time">
            <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
            {% with authors=post.authors.all() %}
                {%- if authors -%}
                    {{ link_users(authors) }}
                {%- endif -%}
            {% endwith %}
            <div style="float: right">
                <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>
                {{ relative_time(post.publish_on, abs=_('o{time}'), rel=_('{time}')) -}}
                <span class="comment-data">
                    <a href="{{ url('blog_post', post.id, post.slug) }}#comments" class="comment-count-link">
                        <i class="fa fa-comments comment-icon"></i><span class="comment-count">
                            {{- post_comment_counts[post.id] or 0 -}}
                        </span>
                    </a>
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>
```

```
{% extends "base.html" %}
{% block title_row %}
{% endblock %}
{% block title_ruler %}{% endblock %}

{% block media %}
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/atom+xml" href="{{ url('blog_atom') }}" title="Atom Blog Feed">
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="{{ url('blog_rss') }}" title="RSS Blog Feed">
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/atom+xml" href="{{ url('comment_atom') }}" title="Atom Comment Feed">
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="{{ url('comment_rss') }}" title="RSS Comment Feed">
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/atom+xml" href="{{ url('problem_atom') }}" title="Atom Problem Feed">
    <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="{{ url('problem_rss') }}" title="RSS Problem Feed">
{% endblock %}

{% block js_media %}
    {% include "blog/media-js.html" %}

    <script type="text/javascript">
        $(document).ready(function () {
            $('.time-remaining').each(function () {
                count_down($(this));
            });

            // Newsfeed post collapsing. State is remembered per-post in
            // localStorage so a reader's collapsed posts stay collapsed on reload.
            var COLLAPSE_KEY = 'newsfeed_collapsed_posts';
            function readCollapsed() {
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(COLLAPSE_KEY)) || {};
                } catch (e) {
                    return {};
                }
            }
            function writeCollapsed(state) {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem(COLLAPSE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
                } catch (e) { /* storage unavailable; collapse still works per-session */ }
            }

            function setCollapsed($post, collapsed) {
                var $toggle = $post.find('.blog-collapse-toggle').first();
                var $icon = $toggle.find('i');
                $post.toggleClass('collapsed', collapsed);
                $toggle.attr('aria-expanded', collapsed ? 'false' : 'true');
                $toggle.attr('title', collapsed ? gettext('Expand') : gettext('Collapse'));
                $icon.toggleClass('fa-chevron-up', !collapsed);
                $icon.toggleClass('fa-chevron-down', collapsed);
            }

            var collapsedState = readCollapsed();
            $('.post').each(function () {
                var id = this.id;
                if (collapsedState[id]) {
                    setCollapsed($(this), true);
                }
            });

            $(document).on('click', '.blog-collapse-toggle', function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var $post = $(this).closest('.post');
                var collapsed = !$post.hasClass('collapsed');
                setCollapsed($post, collapsed);
                var state = readCollapsed();
                if (collapsed) {
                    state[$post.attr('id')] = true;
                } else {
                    delete state[$post.attr('id')];
                }
                writeCollapsed(state);
            });

            $('.blog-sidebar').hide();
            $('#blog-tab').find('a').click(function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                $('#blog-tab').addClass('active');
                $('#event-tab').removeClass('active');
                $('.blog-content').show();
                $('.blog-sidebar').hide();
            });
            $('#event-tab').find('a').click(function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                $('#event-tab').addClass('active');
                $('#blog-tab').removeClass('active');
                $('.blog-content').hide();
                $('.blog-sidebar').show();
            });
        });
    </script>
{% endblock %}

{% block body %}
    {% block before_posts %}{% endblock %}
    <div id="mobile" class="tabs">
        <ul>
            <li id="blog-tab" class="tab active"><a href="#">
                <i class="tab-icon fa fa-info-circle"></i> {{ _('Blog') }}
            </a></li>
            <li id="event-tab" class="tab"><a href="#"><i class="tab-icon fa fa-rss"></i> {{ _('Events') }}</a></li>
        </ul>
    </div>
    <div id="blog-container">
        <div class="blog-content sidebox">
            {% include "blog/blog-list-tabs.html" %}
            <div class="sidebox-content" style="border: unset;">
                {% for post in posts %}
                    {% include "blog/blog-post.html" %}
                {% endfor %}
            </div>
            {% if page_obj.has_other_pages() %}
                <div class="bottom-pagination-bar">{% include "list-pages.html" %}</div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <div class="blog-sidebar">
            {% if own_open_tickets %}
                <div class="blog-sidebox sidebox">
                    <h3>{{ _('My open tickets') }} <i class="fa fa-question-circle"></i></h3>
                    <div class="sidebox-content">
                        <ul class="own-open-tickets">
                            {% for ticket in own_open_tickets %}
                                <li>
                                    <div class="title">
                                        <a href="{{ url('ticket', ticket.id) }}">{{ ticket.title }}</a>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="object">
                                        <a href="{{ ticket.linked_item.get_absolute_url() }}">
                                            {{ ticket.linked_item|item_title|truncatechars_html(30) }}</a>
                                    </div>
                                </li>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if open_tickets %}
                <div class="blog-sidebox sidebox">
                    <h3>{{ _('New tickets') }} <i class="fa fa-exclamation-circle"></i></h3>
                    <div class="sidebox-content">
                        <ul class="open-tickets">
                            {% for ticket in open_tickets %}
                                <li>
                                    <div class="title">
                                        <a href="{{ url('ticket', ticket.id) }}">{{ ticket.title }}</a>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="object">
                                        <a href="{{ ticket.linked_item.get_absolute_url() }}">
                                            {{ ticket.linked_item|item_title|truncatechars_html(30) }}</a>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="author">{{ link_user(ticket.user) }}</div>
                                </li>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}
            {% if current_contests %}
                <div class="blog-sidebox sidebox">
                    <h3>
                        <span>{{ _('Ongoing contests') }}</span>
                    </h3>
                    <div class="sidebox-content sidebox-ongoing-contest">
                        {% for contest in current_contests %}
                            <div class="contest">
                                <div class="contest-list-title">
                                    <a href="{{ url('contest_view', contest.key) }}">{{ contest.name }}</a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="time">
                                    {{ _('Ends in %(countdown)s.', countdown=as_countdown(contest.time_before_end)) }}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if future_contests %}
                <div class="blog-sidebox sidebox">
                    <h3>
                        <span>{{ _('Upcoming contests') }}</span>
                        
                    </h3>
                    <div class="sidebox-content">
                        {% for contest in future_contests %}
                            <div class="contest">
                                <div class="contest-list-title">
                                    <a href="{{ url('contest_view', contest.key) }}">{{ contest.name }}</a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="time">
                                    {{ _('Starting in %(countdown)s.', countdown=as_countdown(contest.time_before_start)) }}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if top_rated_users %}
                {% include "blog/top-rating.html" %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if top_contrib %}
                {% include "blog/top-contrib.html" %}
            {% endif %}
            <div class="blog-sidebox sidebox">
                <h3 style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; white-space: nowrap;">
                    <span style="margin-right: 10px;">
                        {{ _('Comment stream') }}
                    </span>
                    {% if misc_config.discord_invite_link and misc_config.discord_invite_shieldio %}
                        <span style="margin: 0.1em 0.3em -6px;">
                            <a href="{{ misc_config.discord_invite_link }}">
                                <img style="max-width: none;" src="{{ misc_config.discord_invite_shieldio }}" alt="Discord">
                            </a>
                        </span>
                    {% endif %}
                </h3>
                <div class="sidebox-content">
                    <ul>
                        {% for comment in comments %}
                            <li>
                                <span style="padding-left:0.25em" class="poster">
                                    {{ link_user(comment.author) }}
                                </span> &rarr;
                                <a href="{{ comment.link }}#comment-{{ comment.id }}">{{ comment.page_title }}</a>
                            </li>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </ul>
                    <span class="rssatom">
                        <a href="{{ url('comment_rss') }}"><span><i class="fa fa-rss"></i></span> RSS</a>
                        /
                        <a href="{{ url('comment_atom') }}">Atom</a>
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="blog-sidebox sidebox">
                <h3>{{ _('New problems') }} <i class="fa fa-puzzle-piece"></i>
                </h3>
                <div class="sidebox-content">
                    <ul class="problem-list">
                        {% for problem in new_problems %}
                            <li><a href="{{ url('problem_detail', problem.code) }}">{{ problem.name }}</a></li>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </ul>
                    <span class="rssatom">
                        <a href="{{ url('problem_rss') }}"><span><i class="fa fa-rss"></i></span> RSS</a>
                        /
                        <a href="{{ url('problem_atom') }}">Atom</a>
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% block after_posts %}{% endblock %}
{% endblock %}

{% block bodyend %}
    {{ super() }}
    {% if REQUIRE_JAX %}
        {% include "mathjax-load.html" %}
    {% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

                var $toggle = $post.find('.blog-collapse-toggle').first();
                var $icon = $toggle.find('i');
                $post.toggleClass('collapsed', collapsed);
                $toggle.attr('aria-expanded', collapsed ? 'false' : 'true');
                $toggle.attr('title', collapsed ? gettext('Expand') : gettext('Collapse'));
                $icon.toggleClass('fa-chevron-up', !collapsed);
                $icon.toggleClass('fa-chevron-down', collapsed);
            }

function getTextAlignForAngle(angle) {
	if (angle === 0 || angle === 180) {
		return 'center';
	} else if (angle < 180) {
		return 'left';
	}

	return 'right';
}

movable and sizeable.</p>\n\n    <p>For mouse users, dragging any of the edges will enlarge or shrink\n    the dialog box by moving that side.  Dragging any of the corners\n    changes the two sides that meet at that corner.  Dragging elsewhere on\n    the dialog frame will move the dialog without changing its size.</p>\n\n    <p>For keyboard users, there are two ways to adjust the position\n    and size of the dialog box.  The first is to hold the\n    <kbd>Alt</kbd> or <kbd>Option</kbd> key and press any of the arrow\n    keys to move the dialog box in the given direction.  Hold the\n    <kbd>Win</kbd> or <kbd>Command</kbd> key and press any of the\n    arrow keys to enlarge or shrink the dialog box.  Left and right\n    move the right-hand edge of the dialog, while up and down move the\n    bottom edge of the dialog.\n    </p>\n\n    <p>For some users, holding two keys down at once may be difficult,\n    so the second way is to press the <kbd>m</kbd> to start "move"\n    mode, then use the arrow keys to move the dialog box in the given\n    direction.  Press <kbd>m</kbd> again to stop moving the dialog.\n    Similarly, press <kbd>s</kbd> to start and stop "sizing" mode,\n    where the arrows will change the size of the dialog box.</p>\n\n    <p>Holding a <kbd>shift</kbd> key along with the arrow key will\n    make larger changes in the size or position, for either method\n    described above.</p>\n\n    <p>Use <kbd>Tab</kbd> to move among the text, buttons, and links\n    within the dialog.  The <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> key\n    activates the focused item.  The <kbd>Escape</kbd> key closes the\n    dialog, as does clicking outside the dialog box, or clicking the\n    "\xd7" icon in the upper right-hand corner of the dialog.</p>\n  ';class uo extends
